jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description: **About the job** Otavo.ai is a global hiring platform focused on mid\-to\-senior recruitment. We are hiring an AI Architect for one of our clients Apply only thru: https://www.otavo.ai/jobs/cmu9yfiim09jt01t3cosasw3d **About the Company:** A B2B software provider in industrial AI and manufacturing optimization is hiring an AI Architect to work directly with large US\-based OEMs and manufacturing enterprises. The role focuses on identifying and deploying AI opportunities across business functions, spanning manufacturing and supply chain. This is a hands\-on position with significant ownership and impact, reporting to senior stakeholders and business leaders. **Location**: Peoria, Illinois, United States **Compensation**: Base USD 200k\+ **Work mode**: Full\-time, On\-site **US work visa is a must** About the Role We are looking for a Principal AI Architect to own the end\-to\-end architecture of our enterprise AI platform and to set the technical standard for how AI is designed, built, deployed, and governed across the company. This is a deeply technical, hands\-on leadership role for someone who understands AI application architecture at a fundamental level and has repeatedly taken enterprise AI systems from concept to secure, robust, well\-governed production at scale. You will be the trusted technical authority partnering with engineering, data, security, risk, and business leaders to ensure every AI solution is architecturally sound, scalable, compliant with Responsible AI principles, and aligned with where the industry is heading. You will operate fluently across the full AI spectrum — classical machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, and modern LLM / agentic systems — and translate that breadth into reference architectures, guardrails, and production systems that teams across the enterprise build on. The distance between identifying a customer problem and shipping a production solution is measured in weeks, and you'll own that entire journey, from the plant floor to the deployed system. This role is based in Chicago and is on\-site 5 days work from office. Travel: Regular travel to customer sites, accross the US. Expect 50–60%. On non\-travel weeks, you're in the Chicago office five days. You'll spend time in factories, warehouses, engineering offices, planning meetings, and supply chain reviews, understanding how work actually gets done before deciding how software should improve it. What You'll Do Architecture \& Technical Leadership \- Own the end\-to\-end architecture of the enterprise AI platform: orchestration layers, LLM integration patterns, RAG and vector pipelines, agent frameworks, feature stores, model\-serving infrastructure, API mesh, and reusable shared services. \- Define architectural standards, reference designs, patterns, and guardrails that govern how engineering teams build and integrate AI workloads. \- Translate business and product requirements into concrete architecture decisions — selecting design patterns, evaluating and benchmarking frameworks, and assembling reusable components. \- Serve as the design authority in architecture reviews, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, observable, and cost\-efficient. Design, Build \& Deploy (Hands\-On) \- Design and build production AI systems spanning classical ML, deep learning, computer vision, and generative/LLM workloads. \- Architect agentic AI systems — multi\-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, memory systems, and planning/reasoning patterns — using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and Semantic Kernel. \- Work hands\-on with foundation models: prompt and context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), fine\-tuning/adaptation, evaluation, and custom model integration. \- Evaluate and integrate core AI infrastructure: vector databases, embedding models, orchestration layers, and observability/evaluation tooling. Production, MLOps \& LLMOps \- Establish and mature the full model lifecycle: CI/CD for models and prompts, automated testing, environment strategy, deployment, rollback, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining. \- Build observability, evaluation, reliability, and cost\-management practices for LLM\- and ML\-based systems running in production. \- Ensure systems meet enterprise SLAs for latency, availability, and cost at scale. Security, Robustness \& Governance \- Embed security by design: data protection, secrets management, access control, tenant isolation, and defense against prompt injection, data exfiltration, model, and supply\-chain risks. \- Operationalize Responsible AI and governance — safety, risk management, transparency, explainability, human\-in\-the\-loop design, bias monitoring, and regulatory alignment (e.g., GDPR/CCPA, HIPAA, EU AI Act, and applicable industry regulations). \- Partner with security, legal, privacy, and risk teams to ensure compliance with enterprise architecture and data\-governance standards. Influence \& Enablement \- Advise CIO/CTO and senior business leaders on AI strategy, build\-vs\-buy decisions, and platform investment. \- Mentor senior engineers and architects; raise the AI engineering bar across the organization. \- Track the evolving AI landscape and steer the enterprise toward durable, forward\-looking choices. What You Bring (Required) \- 10\+ years in software engineering / enterprise architecture, with 5\+ years architecting and deploying production AI/ML systems at enterprise scale. (Exceptional candidates with less tenure but clearly stronger depth will be considered.) \- Demonstrated depth across the AI stack: \- Machine Learning \& Deep Learning — model development, training, evaluation, and productionization. \- Computer Vision — detection, classification, segmentation, and deployment (including edge/real\-time where relevant). \- LLMs / Generative AI — architecting and operationalizing LLM\-driven applications; RAG, agents, fine\-tuning, prompt/context engineering, function calling, and evaluation. \- AI Ops (MLOps/LLMOps) — CI/CD, observability, drift/retraining, reliability, and cost management in production. \- Proven track record designing enterprise\-grade AI solutions on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including enterprise integration and API design. \- Deep, demonstrable experience delivering AI systems that are secure, robust, and well\-governed — not just prototypes. \- Strong grasp of Responsible AI, model risk, and regulatory/compliance considerations. \- Fluency in Python and the modern AI/ML ecosystem (e.g., PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain/LangGraph/Semantic Kernel, vector databases, containers/Kubernetes). \- Excellent communication — able to operate from executive strategy down to hands\-on implementation. Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field. Preferred / Top\-Candidate Signals \- Master's or PhD in a relevant discipline, or equivalent demonstrated depth. \- Experience with agentic/multi\-agent architectures in production. \- Background in a regulated or safety\-critical / industrial enterprise environment. \- Contributions to open source, patents, publications, or recognized thought leadership in AI. \- Experience defining enterprise AI reference architectures adopted across multiple teams. Why This Role \- End\-to\-end ownership of the enterprise AI platform — you set the standard, not just implement it. \- Full\-spectrum scope — classical ML, DL, CV, and modern LLM/agentic systems in one mandate. \- Real production impact at enterprise scale, with security and governance treated as first\-class. \- Uncapped for the right person — compensation is not a barrier for a truly competitive candidate. Pay: $200,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule Application Question(s): * Do you have 10\+ years of experience in software engineering or enterprise architecture, with at least 5 years architecting and deploying production AI/ML systems at enterprise scale? Yes/No * Which major cloud platform(s) have you designed enterprise\-grade AI solutions on? * Do you have a valid US work Visa? * Why do you think you are a good fit for this role? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Building Automation Engineer (BACnet/Modbus/PLC)
jobs.description: **Building Automation Engineer (BACnet / Modbus / PLC)** **Uriel Management — Dallas/Fort Worth, TX (Hybrid)** Full\-time \| $95,000 – $135,000 per year, based on experience AI is coming to building controls, and we're the ones putting it in the building. Uriel Management is a technology company bringing AI\-driven control to commercial buildings across Texas, backed by a 45\-year HVAC and controls contractor. You'll work on real equipment in real buildings, not demos. We need an engineer who can walk into a site running Trane Tracer, Niagara, Metasys, Distech, or a no\-name gateway, get it talking to our AI over BACnet or Modbus, write the control sequence, and commission it. **Why you'll want this job** * You own the whole problem. From getting a device to show up on the bus, to the sequence running and proven on a trend, it's yours end to end. Nobody hands you a spec and walks away. * New equipment every week, not the same building for three years. A dozen BAS brands, hundreds of sites, every gateway ever made. If you like the puzzle, you'll never run out. * Small team, direct line to the CTO. Your integration goes live the week you finish it. No ticket queue, no six layers of review. * Top\-of\-market pay: $95,000 – $135,000 plus performance bonus. We pay for engineers who can actually make the network talk. * Code counts here. Python, protocols, and PLC logic in the same role, a combination that makes you more valuable everywhere you go next. * Controls meets AI. You'll work where control sequences and machine learning overlap, a skill set almost nobody in this industry has yet. * Remote most days, DFW site visits when the panel needs eyes. No forty hours a week of windshield time. * 45 years of HVAC and controls behind you. Real customers, real equipment, real problems worth solving. **What you'll do** * Integrate our systems with existing building automation platforms at customer sites over BACnet/IP, BACnet MSTP, Modbus TCP, and Modbus RTU * Write, test, and commission control sequences for HVAC and building equipment; tune loops and validate points end to end * Configure and program PLCs, DDC controllers, and gateways; build device drivers and point maps for equipment we haven't seen before * Script integrations and tools in Python (or similar) against controller and vendor APIs * Diagnose communication faults remotely and on site: device discovery, addressing, termination, register maps, trend and alarm review * Build and support demand response sequences: load\-shed and setpoint strategies, event execution, and verification from trend data * Work directly with our CTO on integration work and with field techs on installs; produce control narratives, point lists, and as\-builts **You must have** * 3\+ years programming and commissioning PLCs or DDC controllers, and you can name the platforms and tools you used * Hands\-on BACnet, both IP and MSTP, including troubleshooting discovery and addressing problems * Hands\-on Modbus, both TCP and RTU, including register mapping and byte\-order problems * Working code in at least one general\-purpose language (Python preferred; C/C\+\+, C\#, or JavaScript fine), plus Structured Text or Ladder * Commissioning experience: point\-to\-point checkout, loop tuning, FAT/SAT, sequence validation * Familiar with AI: you use AI tools daily for code, docs, and troubleshooting, and you understand how machine learning models consume and act on building data * Willingness to be on site in DFW as needed; most work is remote **Nice to have** * Trane Tracer SC\+ / Ensemble energy management systems; Niagara N4 certification; Distech, JCI Metasys, Siemens Desigo, or Honeywell experience * Allen\-Bradley Studio 5000 or Siemens TIA Portal * MQTT, OPC UA, REST APIs, Linux, SQL * Demand response or utility program experience * Applied machine learning or data analysis in Python (pandas, scikit\-learn, time\-series forecasting) * Experience supporting controls across many sites rather than one large building **Pay \& benefits** * $95,000 – $135,000 per year, based on experience * Performance bonus * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off and paid holidays * Additional benefits package * Hybrid: remote most days, DFW site visits when a job needs eyes on the panel **Apply** Send a resume that names the platforms, protocols, and languages you've used. If you've got a project you're proud of, tell us what the sequence did and what broke during commissioning. Apply through Indeed. Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Northlake, TX 76262

jobs.title: Database Developer (SQL)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will design and build the data layer for a federal enterprise platform. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you taking responsibility for the accuracy and performance of your assigned components. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Design database schemas, and write the views, stored procedures, functions, and Structured Query Language (SQL) queries that run on them. * Build and maintain data pipelines and extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT) processes, including loads from Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\). * Make queries and databases fast enough for high\-volume workloads. * Help model data across Amazon Web Services (AWS) stores such as Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), Amazon DynamoDB, and S3\. * Keep data accurate and secure, with governed access and changes that can be audited. * Work out data access patterns and integrations with developers, architects, and data engineers. * Where the work allows, use artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted tools for query, pipeline, and troubleshooting work, and review and validate what they produce. You deliver database components accurate and fast enough that analysts and systems trust them. You automate the loads and checks that used to be run by hand, and you build models that keep working as the platform grows. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of database development experience * Bachelor's degree * Working expertise in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), covering schema design, stored procedures and functions, and indexing * Experience with Amazon DynamoDB, covering data modeling and Global and Local Secondary Indexes (GSIs and LSIs) * SQL skills across complex queries, views, stored procedures, and functions, together with relational design, normalization, and data modeling * Performance and query tuning that addresses slow queries through indexing and execution\-plan work * ETL and ELT development and data integration across AWS data services such as Aurora, DynamoDB, and S3 * Experience working within data security controls such as encryption, access management, and auditing * Experience loading data from S3 into the platform stores and connecting through Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) * Experience making logical data modeling and database\-design decisions for assigned components within an established platform architecture * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * An AWS certification at the associate level, such as Developer Associate or Solutions Architect Associate * Experience tuning queries that involve locking and deadlocks * Familiarity with supporting cloud\-native applications in AWS through continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) practices * Ownership of physical design for Aurora and DynamoDB schemas and indexes, or the drive to grow into it * Experience in federal information technology or high\-volume transaction environments * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tools **Who you are** You enjoy building with SQL and take responsibility for getting data right. You can take a database problem from design through delivery and stand behind how your work performs. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Solid SQL on a modern relational platform, Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), with stored procedures, functions, and views that hold up in use. * Practical skill in query tuning against slow queries, indexing, and execution plans, together with data loading, connectivity, version control, and clean delivery. * Practical experience developing logical data models and database schemas, and making database\-design decisions for assigned components within the established platform architecture. * The ability to own assigned database work from design through maintenance, working within data security controls, with sound judgment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: Founding Engineer

We’ve raised $3M from Y Combinator and other notable investors, and have grown from 0 to 500\+ customers since launching at the start of the year. Fernstone was founded by **James** (BCG, Traba, UChicago), and **Bryant** (Google, SentiLink, Vanderbilt). We work in\-person in our NYC office. **The role:** As founding engineer (and engineering hire \#2\), you’ll have a substantial role in building our product. You’ll work directly with the operators using your product, own critical systems across the stack, and help set the technical direction of the company. Your work will have a direct impact on how we operate, serve customers, and grow. **What you’ll work on:** * Own outcomes: partner with our operations team to learn how insurance work gets done, identify the biggest opportunities, and decide what to build. * Build across the stack: Design and build complete features across the interface, application logic, data model, and infrastructure. * Engineer for the real world: Create reliable workflows where accuracy matters, outside systems fail, and events may unfold over days or weeks * Develop practical AI: Build systems that interpret information, automate multi\-step work, and recognize when a person needs to step in. **What we look for:** * 2\+ YOE * You’ve shipped and maintained production software that people depend on. * You can take an ambiguous business problem, ask good questions, and turn it into a focused solution. * You have strong backend and relational database fundamentals, and you’re comfortable building a polished frontend. * You think carefully about data correctness, failure handling, and how systems behave after deployment. * You have practical experience building with language models, including evaluating their output and handling mistakes. * You use AI development tools effectively and take responsibility for understanding, reviewing, and debugging the code you ship. Target Customers * Humanoid robotics companies * Embodied AI and foundation model teams * Autonomous systems and industrial AI companies * AI research organizations * Companies developing computer vision, perception, manipulation, or robot learning systems Responsibilities * Identify and contact potential B2B customers * Build and manage your sales pipeline * Introduce our data services to qualified prospects * Understand their AI and robotics data requirements * Help move qualified opportunities toward commercial agreements Our US team will provide product information, technical materials, pricing support, and assistance during commercial discussions. jobs.title: Junior DevSecOps Engineer (CI/CD)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will help run the secure cloud infrastructure, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and automation behind federal systems. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you working alongside engineers on the pipelines a team relies on every day. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build and maintain pipelines and deployment automation, with senior engineers guiding you. * Help write infrastructure as code in Terraform or CloudFormation. * Add security scanning, vulnerability checks, and policy controls to the delivery pipeline. * Help run Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments and Docker containers, including orchestration, monitoring, and logging. * Help map and implement National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800\-53 (NIST SP 800\-53\) controls, and automate the compliance evidence. * Script repeatable operational tasks in Python, Bash, or PowerShell, and fix the findings that come back. * Use artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted tools for scripting, testing, and pipeline work, and check everything they produce. Your work goes through code review, and you explain what you changed and why. That is how you learn why a change is right rather than only that it works. You automate what the team does by hand, and you build your part of the practice that puts security in early rather than bolting it on. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 1\+ years of experience in software development, platform engineering, or operations engineering * A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related technical discipline * Scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell * Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and hands\-on experience with at least one pipeline tool * Familiarity with AWS cloud services, and with Docker and containerization * A basic grasp of container orchestration concepts * Exposure to infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation * Foundational Linux experience * Knowledge of networking concepts, application programming interfaces, load balancing, and web applications * An understanding of cloud security principles and secure software delivery practices * The ability to troubleshoot issues in infrastructure and deployments * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot for code generation and review * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Exposure to NIST SP 800\-53 controls, Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) compliance, or Authority to Operate (ATO) processes * Experience with vulnerability scanning or security tooling, such as static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), or policy\-as\-code * Hands\-on delivery of production workloads on AWS, or an AWS certification * Experience in federal information technology **Who you are** You treat security and reliability as part of the build, not a gate at the end, and you are highly motivated to develop as an engineer who automates what others do by hand and leaves an audit trail behind. You ask when you are stuck rather than guessing, you take feedback as the fastest route forward, and when priorities shift, you shift with them. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * A foundation in scripting, Linux, networking, cloud fundamentals, and delivery automation, and a real appetite to go deeper on the security side. * The delivery habits, or the willingness to build them fast: version control, automated testing, code review, and secure configuration. * The communication to say clearly what you have done, what you are stuck on, and what you need. * The precision to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $80,000 to $95,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

jobs.title: Member of Mathematical Staff
jobs.description: **At SF Tensor, we're building the future of high\-performance compute** ======================================================================== We firmly believe that the future of AI depends on the unglamorous: rethinking and rebuilding the stack, all the way down. From the hardware underneath it to the compiler targeting it and the cloud running it. Right now those three things fight each other and that friction shows up as a tax on every researcher trying to build something ambitious. We're here to axe that tax and make compute faster, cheaper and more available. When we succeed, compute will be portable enough that "which cloud, which chip" stop being something you worry about. To achieve this, we are building our Kernel Optimizer, which takes code and finds its fastest possible form for whatever vendor and cluster topology you point it at, automatically, as well as the Model Foundry which manages the runs, makes research easier and moves workloads across clouds and chips as prices and availability ship, instead of leaving you locked into whatever vendor you signed with first. We're backed by Susa Ventures, Y Combinator, along with some great funds and angels including Max Mullen and Paul Graham, as well as founders and executives at Neuralink, Notion and AMD. We're looking for researchers, engineers and organizations who agree with the basic premise: you don't get the next leap in AI without a leap in compute first. **About the Role** ------------------ We build the fastest GPU compiler in the world. Most compilers have to preserve correctness at every transform, constraining how far they can search, while we prove correctness at the end instead, allowing us to search a far wider space, with agents, with RL, with anything that works and still guarantees the result. It's why we hold \#1 on NVIDIA's own kernel benchmark across hundreds of production kernels. Our core proof machinery is real and it works, but right now there are some rough edges that limit the number of kernels we can prove. With the rise of AI capabilities in mathematics combined with our bit\-identical models and tools, such as our own model for large\-scale Lean proof writing, things that were nearly impossible just a few months ago are now totally viable, but we need someone who figures out what theory we're missing, builds it and then coordinates with the engineering team to deploy it at scale, which is why we are hiring a Member of Mathematical Staff to own the math behind the proof engine and other surfaces for applying rigorous math to an increasingly wishy\-washy domain. This is not an advisory role and you'll have access to better tooling than anywhere else, such as bit\-exact software models of hardware components like the **tcgen05**, a compiler capable of emitting code at a lower level than publicly possible, and frontier models with capabilities tailored to what your work needs, trained with our team. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * You'll own the proof engine end\-to\-end, ensuring we can prove kernels across all edge cases * You'll collaborate with the engineering team on building formal models of new hardware * You'll work on formalizing numeric stability and what drives model convergence across diverse architectures * You'll work on research around the extent to which we can predict training divergence during runs * You'll collaborate with the research team on our post\-training efforts around formal proofs and program verification * You'll work on formalizing low\-precision computation and its numerical stability * You'll collaborate with the engineering team on formally proving sandboxes safe **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * A PhD in Math is strongly recommended but not required: what matters is what you've proven and built * Someone with good judgement about when a full proof is worth it and when a cheaper guarantee is enough * Someone who's pragmatic about tooling and knows when SMT works, when an interactive proof is necessary and when custom decision procedures are necessary * Someone who's comfortable owning an open\-ended problem where you set the research agenda yourself * Someone who can explain a proof strategy to an engineer who doesn't know the math, and push back when they want to cut corners **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Someone who's contributed to projects such as Mathlib, Flocq or seL4\. * Someone with hands\-on experience working with Lean or Rocq * Someone who's done work or published in the field of program verification * Someone who's done work or published in the field of numerical analysis or numerics * Someone who's done work or published in the field of optimization theory or the dynamics of stochastic training * Someone with deep knowledge in the field of floating\-point formalization **Why Join Us** --------------- You will sit in the only place in the world right now working on guaranteeing the correctness and training stability of frontier models, which is one of the most important problems of our time, with the tools and freedom to actually solve it. The truth is that most formal methods work never leaves the paper and most ML work never gets near a proof. Here, the proof engine decides what is allowed to ship into production, so your work sits on the critical path of everything we do and gets tested against more kernels in a day than most verification tools see in their lifetime. We invest heavily in AI tooling for mathematics, from our own model for large\-scale Lean proof writing to bit\-exact models of the hardware, so you spend your time on the theory and not the tedium, and get from idea to proof as fast as possible. Beyond that, the people who reverse\-engineered the tensor cores, write the compiler and train the models you are proving and using for your mathematics are the same people you eat lunch with, so when a proof hinges on what the silicon actually does, the answer is a conversation away. We're a small team operating at frontier scale. We pre\-trained foundation models on 4,000 AMD GPUs as a team of three, designed and brought up GB300 NVL72 clusters and designed a TOP500 supercomputer. We believe that hard problems get solved in person and most of our work happens at our office in San Francisco. We offer relocation assistance and, where possible, we'd like you here as often as possible. The base salary range for this full\-time position is $225,000\-$315,000, plus meaningful equity and benefits. Compensation Range: $225K \- $315K

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description: Onboarding Engineer – Building Controls URIEL Management — Dallas/Fort Worth, TX (Hybrid, travel across Texas) Full\-time \| $70,000 – $95,000 per year \+ bonus, based on experience URIEL Management is a technology company bringing AI\-driven control to commercial buildings across Texas, backed by a 45\-year HVAC and controls contractor. Every new customer site goes through our onboarding process, from signed contract to live on our platform. We need one person who owns that process and makes sure nothing gets missed. This job is about attention to detail. You’re the person who reads the whole email, checks the work twice, follows up before anyone has to ask, and doesn’t call something done until it’s actually done. **Why you’ll want this job** * You own it. Every new site runs through you. When a customer goes live on schedule with everything right, that’s your work. * Your care shows. Customers see the results of your accuracy every day on their dashboards and reports. * Small team, direct line to leadership. You work daily with the CEO and CTO. No bureaucracy. * Room to grow. You’ll learn controls, networking, and program management, and grow into operations leadership as we scale. * Controls meets AI. You’ll help connect real buildings to an AI platform, work almost nobody in this industry is doing yet. **What you’ll do** * Own the onboarding checklist for every new site and make sure every item is completed, verified, and recorded in our platform * Keep the master schedule and site trackers accurate and current so anyone can see exactly where every site stands * Confirm paperwork, site information, and customer contacts are complete before anything is scheduled * Schedule installs with customers and installation crews, and keep everyone informed before, during, and after * Set up new sites and customer accounts in our platform * Support installers on install day and verify each site is fully live and correct within 48 hours * Close out every site completely: records, photos, schedule updates, billing handoff, and customer go\-live notice * Follow up relentlessly on anything outstanding, from customers, installers, or our own team, until it’s resolved * Improve our checklists and processes whenever you find a gap **You must have** * A track record of getting the details right. You double\-check your own work, catch mistakes others miss, and finish what you start * Experience owning a process or project with lots of moving parts: multiple sites, deadlines, and people * Strong organization: spreadsheets, trackers, and schedules you keep current without being reminded * Clear, professional communication by phone, email, and in person * Working knowledge of building controls or HVAC, or a technical background you can apply to it quickly * Comfortable with web\-based software and learning new platforms; you use AI tools in your daily work * Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel to sites across Texas, including occasional overnights **Nice to have** * Building automation experience (BACnet, Trane, JCI, Siemens, Honeywell, Niagara, or similar) * Basic IP networking * Experience coordinating contractors or field crews * Multi\-site rollouts for retail, restaurant, or dealership portfolios * Project coordination or scheduling tools (Smartsheet, MS Project, or similar) **Pay \& benefits** * $70,000 – $95,000 per year, based on experience * Performance bonus * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off and paid holidays * Additional benefits package * Hybrid: remote most days, site travel as rollouts require **Apply** Send your resume and a short note telling us about a time you caught an error before it became a problem. Apply through Indeed. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Roanoke, TX 76262

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer — Inventory & Fulfillment Platform
jobs.description: **Position Details** * **Employment:** Full\-time, permanent W\-2 employee. * **Location:** Fully remote within the United States. No office attendance required. * **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 40 working hours per week; Saturday and Sunday off. * **Working hours:** Flexible start and finish times, with collaboration hours from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Meal breaks are separate from working hours. * **Base salary:** $175,000–$205,000 USD annually before taxes, paid biweekly. * **Reports to:** Engineering Manager. * **Travel:** None required. **About Stocklane** Stocklane Technologies develops software that helps online retailers synchronize inventory, coordinate warehouse fulfillment, and track orders across sales channels. Our remote team builds practical tools that make complex retail operations easier to manage. **About the Role** You will build the backend services that keep inventory accurate and orders moving through Stocklane Cloud. Your work will include warehouse integrations, order routing, and reliable processing of inventory updates. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. You will own projects from technical design through release and collaborate with Product, Customer Success, and fellow engineers. **What You’ll Do** * Develop APIs and backend services for inventory, order routing, and fulfillment workflows. * Build integrations with online stores, warehouse systems, and shipping providers. * Design event processing that safely handles duplicate messages, delayed updates, and service failures. * Improve PostgreSQL data models, query performance, and transaction handling. * Write automated tests and introduce monitoring that helps identify problems before they affect customers. * Investigate production issues during working hours and implement lasting fixes. * Review code, document design decisions, and support other engineers through feedback and mentoring. * Break larger projects into manageable releases and communicate progress and risks. **What You’ll Bring** * Five or more years of professional backend engineering experience. * Strong experience building production applications with Python and FastAPI or Django. * Solid PostgreSQL skills, including schema design, indexing, and query optimization. * Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, and third\-party integrations. * Practical knowledge of message queues, background jobs, retries, and idempotency. * Experience deploying and maintaining cloud applications, preferably on AWS. * Confidence with automated testing, Git, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows. * Clear written and spoken English and experience collaborating independently in a remote team. A college degree is not required. Relevant professional experience and sound engineering judgment are what matter. **Nice to Have** Experience with inventory management, warehouse software, Shopify, distributed systems, Redis, or Terraform. Familiarity with every tool in our stack is not expected. **Our Stack** Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions. **Compensation and Work Expectations** The annual base salary range is $175,000–$205,000\. Placement within the range depends on relevant experience, technical skills, and demonstrated project ownership. The same range applies across eligible U.S. locations. Compensation is reviewed annually. The stated range excludes benefits; no bonus or equity is included in this sample package. We plan delivery around a 40\-hour workweek. This role has no scheduled evening or weekend shifts and no after\-hours on\-call rotation. **Benefits** * **Medical, dental, and vision:** Coverage starts on the first day of the month following hire. Stocklane covers 90% of employee premiums and 50% of dependent premiums. * **401(k):** Eligibility after 90 days, with a dollar\-for\-dollar employer match on the first 4% of eligible pay contributed. Employer contributions vest immediately. * **Paid leave:** 20 vacation days accrued annually, 7 paid sick days, and 10 paid company holidays. * **Parental leave:** 8 weeks of paid leave after 12 months of employment. * **Insurance:** Company\-paid basic life and short\-term disability coverage. * **Remote setup:** Company laptop, monitor, and accessories, plus a one\-time $750 home\-office allowance. * **Internet:** Reimbursement of up to $75 per month. * **Learning:** Up to $1,500 annually for approved courses, certifications, books, and conferences. * **Onboarding:** Paid product and architecture training, with an assigned engineering buddy. **Our Team Culture** We value curious people who communicate clearly, follow through, and treat colleagues with respect. You will have time for focused work and teammates available when a problem needs another perspective. We encourage questions, give practical feedback, and document decisions so everyone can contribute. When something goes wrong, we work together to understand it and improve the system. Social activities are optional, and personal time is respected. **Your First 90 Days** * **First month:** Learn the platform, understand the main data flows, and ship a scoped improvement with support. * **Second month:** Own a backend feature or integration update through testing and release. * **Third month:** Lead a project independently and propose an improvement to reliability or performance. Success means delivering maintainable software, making thoughtful technical decisions, and collaborating effectively. **Hiring Process** * A 30\-minute introductory audio call with the Engineering Manager. * A 60\-minute practical coding and debugging session. * A 60\-minute system design and team discussion. No unpaid take\-home project is required. The process typically takes two to three weeks, with time for your questions at each stage. **Eligibility and Application** Candidates must reside in the United States and be authorized to work without employer visa sponsorship. An English\-language résumé is required. A cover letter, GitHub profile, or public portfolio is optional. We welcome relevant experience gained in different industries and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Pay: $175,000\.00 \- $205,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

exposure in a quantitative field. * Proven experience leading company\-wide initiatives across multiple teams or influencing tech roadmap planning. * Effective collaboration with diverse teams and stakeholders to drive tangible business outcomes. * Demonstrated ability to balance execution and velocity with in\-depth research, statistical understanding, and scalable design. * Track record of mentoring and investing in the development of scientists, engineers, and peers. * Experience providing technical leadership on significant projects, covering ETL frameworks, metrics stores, infrastructure management, and data security. * Proficiency in building, deploying, and maintaining reliable multi\-geographical data pipelines at scale. * Familiarity with workflow or orchestration and development of standard framework modules, high\-performance services, and client libraries for big data using tools like GCP, Databricks, BigQuery, DataProc, Kafka, Kubernetes, Spark, DataFlow, jobs.title: Senior Principal, Technology Consulting (m/f/x)
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Who We Are** AmaliTech is a global consulting and technology services provider, enabling businesses to scale their digital capabilities, accelerate innovation, and bridge critical tech talent gaps. With a team of over 500 professionals operating across Germany, the US, Ghana, and Rwanda, we blend the strategic insight of tier\-one consulting expertise with the technical excellence of certified software engineers and data scientists to deliver digital solutions at globally competitive rates. Our services \- spanning consulting, AI, data analytics, cloud transformation, cybersecurity, web \& app development, and managed services \- are tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients while ensuring smooth, real\-time collaboration across global teams. As a social business, we reinvest our surplus into initiatives that advance skill\-building and inclusion in the tech space in sub\-Saharan Africa. **What AmaliTech Offers** * **Startup\-level ownership and decision\-making:** This practice is less than a year old, and you are joining early enough to shape it. We move fast, with flat hierarchies, quick decision\-making, and low bureaucracy. * **Unusually high ownership from the start:** From early on, you will own your client account(s), oversee your delivery teams, and have the opportunity to contribute to our business development. * **Accelerated leadership trajectory:** This role is designed for someone ready to make the transition from leading workstreams to leading engagements, from supporting client relationships to owning them, and from contributing to a consulting practice to helping build one. * **Senior mentorship:** Direct mentorship and support from our CEO (Martin Hecker, former Senior Partner at BCG, where he led the Technology Advantage practices across CEMA and the United States) and our COO (Christian Ruckteschler, formerly at BCG and the World Bank Group, and a graduate of Harvard University and the University of Oxford). * **Tech \& AI innovation:** Alongside our partners (including AWS, Microsoft, Anthropic, and others), we use AI both as a client value\-creation lever and within our own delivery model. We care less about AI strategy decks than about applications, workflows, and operating changes that actually get deployed. * **International exposure, focused travel:** With our team and clients spread across Germany, the US, Ghana, and Rwanda (with additional locations in planning), your work will be truly global from day one and include regular travel opportunities. Unlike traditional consulting setups, our travel is focused and periodic – you are not expected to be on\-site with clients on a weekly basis. * **A mission\-driven workplace:** We exist to reposition Africa on the global technology map and to foster tech ecosystems that generate opportunity and prosperity for generations to come. This is not a side narrative but is anchored in our business model and ownership structure. **Job Description** **About The Role** We are building a technology consulting practice focused on private\-equity\-backed companies and technology\-enabled value creation. Founded in 2026 by our CEO and COO – both former BCG consultants – the practice is growing rapidly. You will join at a stage where the operating model, methodologies, team structure, propositions, and client portfolio are still being built, giving you the opportunity to help shape them alongside us. Typical engagements in this practice include: * Identifying and prioritizing tech\-enabled value creation levers for portfolio companies * Building data platforms and AI\-driven analytics capabilities * Delivering KPI dashboards and reporting for senior management and investors * Developing AI\-enabled applications and automation * Overseeing large transformation programs (e.g., ERP migrations) You will combine the strategic outlook of a trusted advisor to senior executives and investors with the hands\-on discipline of owning technical implementation and delivery oversight – a role that shapes a client's digital agenda from the boardroom to the build. Building this practice also means growing it from within, developing ambitious young tech professionals from our locations in Ghana and Rwanda into capable consultants and future leaders of our consulting practice. Every engagement we deliver contributes directly to building globally competitive tech ecosystems and career opportunities in our African locations. **What You'll Own** *You are not expected to have done all of this independently before. We expect you to grow into this level of responsibility quickly, initially with close support from our CEO and COO.* * **Client relationships:** You will quickly grow into primary ownership of selected client relationships, initially working closely alongside our CEO and COO. * **Engagement leadership:** You will run engagements end to end, including scope, timeline, budget, and risk. * **Escalations:** You will manage escalations directly, including situations where a vendor or workstream is underperforming. * **Commercial ownership:** You will help turn successful delivery into lasting client relationships – identifying follow\-on opportunities, shaping proposals and scopes, and protecting engagement economics. * **Practice development:** You will help build the technology consulting practice itself, including developing junior and mid\-level consultants from our Ghana and Rwanda hubs into future members of the practice. * **Technical translation:** You will translate business requirements into scoped, deliverable work for our engineering teams, and translate technical constraints back into terms clients can act on. * **AI\-forward delivery:** You will help clients identify where AI and automation genuinely create value, then ensure our delivery teams build toward it. * **Team leadership:** You will lead cross\-functional delivery teams – including engineers, business analysts, and data specialists – based in our African delivery centres. **Qualifications** **What We're Looking For** The common denominator we are looking for is not a particular employer or technology stack: you have combined structured problem\-solving with real technology delivery and are ready to grow from leading major workstreams into owning engagements and client relationships. * 3\-7 years of relevant experience, although trajectory matters more to us than years served. Typically, you will have built your foundation in: + Technology consulting + Digital transformation + Technology\-enabled delivery + IT program management / ERP transformation + Or adjacent fields * **Demonstrated project management rigour**, including experience running structured PMO processes on complex, multi\-workstream engagements. * **A demonstrated bias for ownership:** comfort taking on ambiguous problems and running toward them rather than waiting for a framework or someone else's sign\-off. * **Genuine appetite for delivery, not only advisory work:** you want to be there at go\-live, not just at the recommendation stage. * **Comfort translating between business and technical stakeholders:** you do not need to be an engineer, but you need to have sat close enough to technical delivery to speak the language credibly. * **Stakeholder management:** evidence that you can independently manage senior client stakeholders, with the judgment and presence to grow into primary ownership of C\-level relationships. * **Evidence of commercial instinct:** you understand that good delivery must also create client value and sustainable engagement economics, and can spot opportunities, manage scope, and contribute to shaping follow\-on work. * **A passion for team development and intercultural teaming:** you are excited to work with international delivery teams and to develop talented colleagues from Ghana and Rwanda into strong consultants and future practice leaders. **Strong plusses (not all required):** * Prior exposure to private equity portfolio companies: value creation planning, 100\-day plans, due diligence, or investor/deal\-team reporting. * Experience on an ERP or major enterprise systems of record implementation * German language fluency, given our client base. * Experience directing distributed or offshore/nearshore delivery teams. * Exposure to applied AI or automation initiatives inside enterprise settings. **Additional Information** **Location \& Travel** * Hybrid, based in Germany or the US. * Regular presence at one of our office locations (Cologne, Germany, or Houston, US) * Occasional travel to client sites. * Occasional travel to your teams in Ghana and Rwanda. **How To Apply** Click on "**I'm interested**" to apply. Documents required for applying: * Current CV * Certifications * References (minimum 2\) **Hiring Process** * Application * Online Interviews * Job offer For any enquiries, reach out via nina.gebauer@amalitech.com or richard.botchway@amalitech.com.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Prime Video Product Analytics
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Prime Video is changing the way customers watch movies, TV shows, live events, and channels—offering unparalleled choice and convenience across devices such as Fire TV, mobile phones, game consoles, and connected TVs. We deliver world\-class viewing experiences to customers in over 240 countries and territories. The Prime Video Product Analytics (PVPA) team is a centralized analytics organization supporting the Prime Video Product organization. We bring together Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to deliver comprehensive data tools and insights that drive product decisions and enhance customer experience. Our work spans the full analytics lifecycle—from data infrastructure and pipeline development to advanced analytics, customer insights modeling, AI\-driven solutions, and self\-service reporting. This role sits within the PVPA team focused on out\-of\-app engagement and full\-funnel customer journey analytics. Our mission is to understand and optimize how customers discover, engage with, and return to Prime Video—connecting off\-app marketing touchpoints (such as email, push, a.com, WhatsApp, search engines, and paid media) with in\-app behavior and engagement to build a complete, end\-to\-end view of the customer experience. We harness data across this full funnel—from acquisition and onboarding through long\-term retention—to inform personalization, measure customer engagement and channel effectiveness, and deliver the right content to the right customer at the right time. Key job responsibilities We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) II to join the PVPA team. In this role, you will play a key part in driving customer understanding through data. You will design and build scalable analytics solutions, self\-service reporting tools, and experimentation frameworks, increasingly powered by AI and automation, that give stakeholders across product, marketing, and science a deep, reliable understanding of customer behavior. Your work will directly inform how Prime Video acquires, engages, and retains customers by connecting out\-of\-app signals to in\-app outcomes and enabling faster, more confident decision\-making across the organization. In this role, you will: * Design and maintain scalable data models, pipelines, and reporting tools that enable accurate and timely marketing performance measurement across multiple customer engagement channels (e.g., email, push, X\-site, WhatsApp, paid media). * Lead the design, execution, and analysis of A/B tests to evaluate marketing strategies, targeting logic, and content variations—ensuring statistical rigor and actionable insights. * Deliver deep customer insights by analyzing behavioral data and engagement patterns, helping stakeholder and partner teams better understand customer needs, preferences, and responses to messaging. * Develop dashboards and self\-service tools to enable marketers, product managers, and other stakeholders to explore data, monitor performance, and make informed decisions. * Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams—including Data Scientists, Engineers, Product Managers, and Marketing Managers—to define metrics, surface insights, and influence strategy through data. * Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, using data storytelling to highlight opportunities, surface risks, and drive alignment on next steps. * Champion data accuracy, consistency, and experimentation best practices to raise the overall bar for measurement and insight generation in Prime Video marketing. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience * 1\+ years of SQL, ETL or Oracle experience * 1\+ years of processing large, multi\-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience * 1\+ years of performing statistical analysis experience * 1\+ years of developing automated reporting experience * 3\+ years of in the job offered or a related occupation experience * 1\+ years of using SQL, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), or Oracle experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field * Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools * Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines * Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab * Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift * Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. USA, WA, SEATTLE \- 99,500\.00 \- 160,000\.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Prime Video Partner Experience & Supply Chain
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Prime Video is a first\-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios\-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add\-on subscriptions such as Apple TV\+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM\+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads. Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best\-in\-class digital video experience. As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end\-to\-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state\-of\-the\-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast\-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people. We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill\-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you! What You'll Do Join Prime Video's Partner Experience \& Supply Chain team as a Business Intelligence Engineer and become the data expert who transforms how we work with our content partners and optimize our supply chain. You'll be the go\-to person for turning complex supply chain data into clear insights that drive real decisions. Working alongside product managers, engineers, and operations teams, you'll build the analytics tools and dashboards that help everyone understand what's working, what's not, and where we should focus next. The Problems You'll Solve Our supply chain generates massive amounts of data, but data alone doesn't drive change \- insights do. You'll tackle questions like: Where are the bottlenecks slowing down content delivery? Which partner workflows need improvement? How can we predict and prevent supply chain issues before they impact customers? You'll create the visibility tools that turn these questions into actionable answers, helping teams spot trends early and make confident, data\-backed decisions. What Makes This Role Different You won't just be running reports \- you'll be a strategic partner shaping how Prime Video manages relationships with content partners and optimizes the entire supply chain. Your work will directly influence how quickly and efficiently we bring content to millions of viewers worldwide. You'll have the autonomy to identify opportunities, propose solutions, and build the tools that matter most. If you love diving deep into data, translating complexity into clarity, and seeing your insights drive tangible improvements, this role offers that impact. Key job responsibilities * Analyze data to identify and execute on business opportunities * Understand data resources and select appropriate sources for each analysis * Build fast prototypes using Amazon AI tools (Kiro, Claude CLI, QuickSuite) and translate them into production\-grade data products * Evaluate requirements and select optimal tools, balancing speed, efficiency, and scalability * Build data pipelines and dashboards from multi\-dimensional datasets to report product metrics and KPIs * Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders verbally and in writing About the team We are part of the central Product and Data Team within the Partner Experience \& Supply Chain organization at Prime Video. Our structure and scope is a hybrid model where we collaborate closely with our tech teams to build data products that solve problems affecting PV customers and our internal stakeholders. We optimize the supply chain and deliver the highest standard of video streaming content to our customers. Our team is the trusted analytical powerhouse that drives unified data solutions, making Prime Video the preferred entertainment destination for customers worldwide.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field * 4\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience * Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools * Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines * Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling * Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift * Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets * Proven ability to determine when and how to integrate GenAI tools, evaluate and refine GenAI outputs, and apply responsible AI practices to augment productivity and quality Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. USA, CA, Culver City \- 99,500\.00 \- 160,000\.00 USD annually USA, WA, SEATTLE \- 99,500\.00 \- 160,000\.00 USD annually

jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer\-centric company on Earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon’s AWS Data Centers are a major component of worldwide cloud\-computing infrastructure and are industry leading examples of mission critical facilities. The pace, scale, and growth of Amazon’s data center platform will challenge you. Our uncompromisingly high standards as we continually seek to innovate on behalf of our customers will push you to new levels of creativity. The Infrastructure Operations organization is looking for an extraordinary individual with proven and tested technical acumen and leadership skills to lead our Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) for AMER. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. A DCEO Principal Engineer is one of our most senior leadership roles in the data center environment. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. In this role you will be responsible for leading the overall infrastructure management (e.g. electrical, mechanical, and HVAC systems) and be accountable for delivering operational excellence in the areas of safety, security, availability of an expanding portfolio of AWS data centers. The role requires a highly driven, self\-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks innovative solutions to highly complex technical problems. This role reports directly to the Director of AMER Operations. The DCEO Principal Engineer is a leader and evangelist, working with and leading cross\-functional teams which include: technical program management, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, control engineering, supply chain management, operations, end users as well as safety and security teams. The ideal candidate should be able to operate comfortably at an strategic and tactical level. It requires the individual to be able to see the big picture, guide, direct, educate, and develop members of the team while at times shifting to being hands\-on on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission\-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand\-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, transfer controllers, UPS units, PDUs, battery technologies and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, EVAP, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors.
