jobs.title: Entry-Level Structural Engineer | Designer
jobs.description: **Position Description** We review candidates for the Entry\-Level Structural Engineer \| Designer position on a rolling basis throughout the year for offices in the United States including, Los Angeles, Oakland, Orange County, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, California; Seattle, Washington; and Detroit and Grand Rapids, Michigan. *Launch your structural engineering career with meaningful work, trusted mentorship, and a team invested in your growth.* You may indicate interest in multiple locations on a **single** application; additional submissions are not necessary. Candidates are considered for one location at a time based on ranked preferences and office availability. **Who Thrives Here** You are a curious, collaborative graduating master's student who wants to understand not only how a solution works, but why it is right for the project. You may be especially interested in seismic analysis for our West Coast offices or steel design for our Michigan offices. You want more than a first job: you want meaningful technical challenges, access to experienced mentors, and a team that trusts you to learn, contribute, and grow. At Degenkolb, early\-career engineers are encouraged to ask thoughtful questions, understand the purpose behind the work, and connect technical decisions to clients, builders, users, and communities. You will be supported as you develop your voice, judgment, and confidence as an engineer. **Who We Are** Founded in 1940 and headquartered in San Francisco, Degenkolb Engineers helps make complex, high\-stakes projects real. We bring deep technical expertise, disciplined creativity, and a practical understanding of construction to every challenge; building strong relationships early, making complexity easier to navigate, and keeping the success of projects central to our work. Our teams deliver customized structural solutions across healthcare, education, science and technology, forensics, construction engineering, federal buildings, and other complex markets. Whether a project calls for navigating stringent codes, balancing budget and schedule, solving an unusual technical problem, or creating a landmark structural system, we connect the right people and ideas to develop solutions that serve our clients and communities. **Position Summary** As a **Designer**, you will contribute to the planning, analysis, and design of structural engineering projects alongside experienced engineers and project managers. Your work will include engineering analyses, contract documents, and project deliverables, with exposure to client collaborations, site visits, and multidisciplinary team delivery of construction projects. This role provides a strong technical foundation through meaningful project work, mentorship, candid feedback, and purposeful professional development. **What You'll Do** * **Structural Analysis \& Design**: Perform structural analysis and design tasks under the guidance of licensed engineers. Apply engineering principles and sound engineering judgment to develop safe, effective structural solutions and contract deliverables that meet the governing building codes. * **Project Delivery \& Quality:** Produce accurate, organized, and high\-quality work that reflects Degenkolb's standards. Build an understanding of project objectives, scope, budget, and schedule; manage assigned work; and communicate progress, questions, and potential issues early. * **Client \& Team Collaboration:** Build trusted relationships with project teams and clients by participating in meetings, supporting client communications, preparing technical documentation, and communicating clearly and professionally in writing and conversation. * **Project Site Experience:** Participate in site visits with experienced engineers to observe existing conditions and construction activities, document field observations, and connect design decisions with how structures are built and perform in the real world. * **Professional Growth \& Development:** Expand your technical knowledge and professional skills through project experience, mentorship, feedback, purposeful learning, challenging assignments, and participation in professional organizations while progressing toward PE licensure. * **Ownership \& Contribution:** Take responsibility for your commitments, seek context when needed, share ideas, and contribute to the collective success of your project teams, office, and firm. **Minimum Requirements** * **Education:** A master's degree in structural engineering is strongly preferred. * **Alternative Path:** Exceptional candidates with a bachelor's degree in civil engineering and one to two years of highly technical structural design experience will be considered if they demonstrate proficiency equivalent to advanced graduate\-level work. * **Core technical** proficiency must be demonstrated through advanced graduate coursework or verified professional project experience in: 1\. Advanced steel design 2\. Advanced reinforced concrete design 3\. Advanced structural analysis 4\. Structural dynamics 5\. Earthquake engineering (West Coast offices) * Undergraduate GPA of 3\.40 or higher; strong academic performance in graduate coursework is expected, where applicable * Unofficial undergraduate and graduate transcripts, as applicable * Professional written and verbal communication skills * Current authorization to work in the United States for any employer **Desired Qualifications** * Passing score on the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam * Additional coursework or experience in wood design, prestressed concrete, or finite element analysis, or * Additional coursework or experience in nonlinear analysis for West Coast office locations * Familiarity with engineering software and tools such as AutoCAD, Tekla, RISA, RAM, Revit, Excel, Mathcad, SAP2000, ETABS, Python, or similar platforms * Demonstrated leadership potential, initiative, and commitment to collaborative learning * Experience in seismic analysis and the design of buildings (West Coast offices) **Compensation \& Benefits** The annual salary range for this position across our offices generally falls between **$87,000 and $115,000**. This range is a good\-faith estimate provided pursuant to applicable pay transparency laws. Actual compensation will be based on factors including work location, company geographic differentials, education, experience, and candidate qualifications. Our benefits are designed to support your well\-being, growth, and long\-term connection to the firm. They include: * Health and life insurance * Commuter benefits * 401(k) with company profit\-sharing contribution * Employee ownership through a privately held stock plan * Financial support for professional activities and development * Company holidays, a generous paid time off program, and paid parental leave **Our Culture** Degenkolb is a place where technical rigor and human connection strengthen one another. Our flexible hybrid work environment brings together experts who are generous with their knowledge, proud of employee ownership, engaged in the profession, and respectful of life outside of work. You will find focused professional development within a supportive and transparent team, variety in project assignments, and opportunities to participate in committees and grow into leadership. Our pay scale is positioned at the 75th market percentile, reflecting the value we place on attracting and retaining exceptional people. Learn more about life at Degenkolb. **How to Apply** Review the available job postings and apply to the single position for which you feel best qualified. jobs.title: Data Engineer with ETL/ELT pipelines and API integrations
jobs.description: Position Title: Data Engineer with ETL/ELT pipelines and API integrations Location: Indianapolis,IN (onsite 5 days per week) Duration: Through December 2026, possible extension into 2027 Job Description Pharmaceutical//'s client is building a governed data and AI platform, integrating device, laboratory, partner, and document data into a unified foundation that supportsregulatoryreporting, advanced analytics, and AI\-driven scientificinsights.The Data Engineer is a hands\-on builder responsible for developing data pipelines, API integrations, and AI infrastructure that bring structured and unstructured data into a governedAzure\-basedarchitecture. This delivery\-focused rolerequires designing, coding, testing, and maintaining production\-ready solutions across both AI document ingestion and structured ETL/ELT data engineering tracks. This role integrates structured and unstructureddata fromlaboratory systems, product lifecycleapplications, and manufacturing partners into a governed Azure\-based data platform, creating a scalable, audit\-ready digital thread that supports analytics, AI, and regulatory compliance. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and maintain production ETL/ELT pipelines integrating laboratory and operational systems (e.g., Darwin, Teamcenter/PLM, LabVantage LIMS, Jama, TurboAC, and Qdocs/Veeva) into Microsoft AzureFabric Lakehouse and PostgreSQL. * Develop and optimize Bronze, Silver, and Gold medallion architecture, including schema mapping, data modeling, referential integrity, and performance optimization. * Build scalable API integrations and cross\-cloud data pipelines across Azure and AWS to support enterprise data integration. * Implement automated data quality controls, controlled vocabulary normalization, schema validation, Q\-gate/specification checks, data lineage, and audit trails to ensure GxP compliance. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize pipeline performance, reliability, error handling, and operational monitoring in production environments. * Collaborate with business, engineering, and IT teams to integrate data sources and establish a governed, scalable digital thread supporting analytics, AI, and regulatory reporting. Required Skills: * 8\+ years of hands\-on Data Engineering experience building production ETL/ELT pipelines and API integrations. * Expert\-level Python and/or PySpark for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, testing, and CI/CD. * Experience with Microsoft Azure Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Factory, Fabric Pipelines, Delta Lake) delivering end\-to\-end production solutions. * Hands\-on AWS experience, including S3, Glue (or equivalent), and RDS/Aurora. * Strong SQL and PostgreSQL experience, including normalized schema design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning. * Experience with data modeling, medallion architecture, and Lakehouse design patterns. * Experience implementing data lineage, quality controls, schema validation, error handling, and monitoring in regulated environments. * Knowledge of GxP, GMP, GCP within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device environments * SCM, WMS, PLM, MM, QA, any validated applications with in a FDA Regulated systems

jobs.title: Vibe Coder / AI Developer
jobs.description: Vibe Coder / AI Developer — Help Build Civra’s LLM In person on Wall Street, NYC \| No college degree required Your résumé can be short. Your ambition can’t. Civra is hiring a hungry, hands\-on vibe coder to help train and improve our LLM, connect it to databases and APIs, and turn ambitious ideas into working software. You know your way around Codex and AI coding tools. You can build fast, understand the code you generate, debug what breaks, and finish what you start. Self\-taught? Bring it. Side projects? Show us. We want curiosity, initiative, and proof you can build. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Build with Codex and other AI coding tools. * Connect databases, APIs, and business systems. * Prepare and organize data for LLM training and evaluation. * Test model outputs, investigate failures, and improve reliability. * Build tools that let our AI retrieve information and take useful actions. * Take features from idea through testing and deployment. **WHAT YOU BRING** * Working ability in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, plus SQL. * Comfort with APIs, authentication, JSON, and webhooks. * Practical knowledge of Git, debugging, testing, and deployment. * Good judgment around credentials, private data, and database access. * Curiosity about LLMs, prompting, retrieval, and evaluation. * Clear communication, urgency, and follow\-through. You don’t need to know everything. You do need to give a damn about getting it right. We supply the tools, resources, and context. You bring the drive to build. This role is in person on Wall Street. You’ll work alongside the team and take ownership of real work that moves Civra forward. **APPLY WITH** * A short introduction and why you want to build Civra. * A project, demo, portfolio, or GitHub link. * An example of something you built using AI coding tools, including what you personally handled. * Your availability and confirmation that you can work in person on Wall Street. Show us something you built. Tell us what you want to build next. Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The Team** AI \& Engineering leverages cutting\-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission\-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology \& data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements. **Qualifications** **Required** * 6\+ years of experience in software, systems, or embedded engineering. * 6\+ years of experience working Java/J2EE. * 6\+ years of experience developing or deploying AI solutions, custom hardware, or high\-performance platforms. * 6\+ years of experience with Linux internals, device drivers, and kernel or embedded systems programming. * Proficient in C/C\+\+ and Python; familiarity with Go or Rust a plus. * Strong understanding of AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX) and performance/model optimization. * Familiarity with hardware\-software co\-design (ASICs, FPGAs, or SoCs). * Demonstrated skill in performance profiling, benchmarking, and system tuning. * Knowledge of distributed systems, cloud/edge computing, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). * Understanding of network protocols, security best practices, and scalable API design. * Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices. Experience working within Agile/Scrum development teams, participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and collaborative solutioning. * Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. **Preferred** * Experience developing or deploying AI solutions, custom hardware, or high\-performance platforms. * Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively. * Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products * Can operate independently or with minimum supervision. * Excellent Written and Communication Skills. * Ability to deliver technical demonstrations. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. jobs.title: Lead Mechanical Engineer, Extrusion Presses & Material Handling
jobs.description: **The challenge** ----------------- Own the full journey—from concept to commissioning—of heavy industrial equipment used in aluminum extrusion. You’ll be the company’s main engineering authority, reporting directly to the President/Owner, and you’ll guide designs, field fixes, shop schedules, and on\-site installations. ### **Your first 90 days** * **Days 1–30:** Dive into active projects, reverse\-engineer an existing press subassembly, and validate key parts with FEA. * **Days 31–60:** Lead a SolidWorks redesign of a handling system, produce manufacturable 2D drawings, and align shop routing to keep machinists and assemblers fully utilized. * **Days 61–90:** Coordinate a billet heater relocation and support a press installation alongside field services; contribute estimates for an upcoming retrofit. ### **Core responsibilities** * Design extrusion presses and associated material handling equipment via 3D modeling. * Reverse\-engineer equipment for repairs, upgrades, and product enhancements. * Troubleshoot with field services to resolve performance and reliability issues. * Plan and oversee movement and installation of presses, handling lines, and billet heaters. * Assist with job quoting and scope definition. * Travel approximately 10%–15%, subject to change based on workload. ### **Qualifications** * 10\+ years in industrial machinery/equipment design. * Demonstrated ability to schedule work through the shop to keep machinists and assemblers busy at all times. * Strong 2D detailing for manufacturing using SolidWorks and AutoCAD. * Hydraulics knowledge for new systems and troubleshooting existing ones. * Working knowledge of FEA with industry\-standard software. * Familiarity with industrial electrical systems and components. ### **Preferred profile** * Experience in the aluminum extrusion sector—designing and troubleshooting. * SolidWorks plus CAM software experience. * 3\+ years designing aluminum extrusion presses and support equipment: billet loaders, stems, containers, tie rods, etc. * BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering. ### **What you’re great at** * Project management and coordinating machine build/assembly activities. * CAD proficiency; mechanical design \& engineering fundamentals. * Product design judgment; pneumatics troubleshooting. * Interpreting and applying FEA results. ### **Tools \& environments** * 3D modeling and 2D drawings. * Industrial controls and extrusion machinery. * AutoCAD, SolidWorks, CAM software. * Allen‑Bradley PLC platforms. ### **Compensation** Pay is based on experience. ### **About Dunaway** For more than four decades, Dunaway has specialized in the design, build, and upgrade of extrusion presses and integrated systems. Our turnkey capabilities span container relines, equipment modernization, system installations, and complete plant redesigns. With in\-house CNC machining to 0\.0005" tolerances, we deliver precision press components. We support customers globally with engineering, consulting, installations, and field services across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia\-Pacific.

jobs.description: **Electrical Engineering Manager** **Job Description** **Department:** Engineering**Job Status:** Full\-Time**FLSA Status:** Salary\-Exempt**Reports To:** Director of Engineering**Location:** Houston, TX (Channelview Area)**Amount of Travel Required:** Varies**Work Schedule:** Monday – Friday, 8 a.m. – 5 p.m.**Positions Supervised:** N/A**AIP Level:** 5 **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Electrical Engineering Manager leads and manages the Electrical Engineering function supporting the design, development, integration, and lifecycle support of power generation equipment and associated electrical systems. This role provides technical leadership across new product development and sustaining engineering, ensures electrical designs meet safety, performance, quality, and applicable industry standards, and works closely with Mechanical, Controls, Project Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Field Operations to deliver reliable and manufacturable solutions. The Electrical Engineering Manager also develops engineering standards, mentors the electrical engineering team, and ensures projects are executed effectively from concept and detailed design through commissioning and operational support. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** (The following duties and responsibilities are all essential job functions, as defined by the ADA, except for those that begin with the word "may")* Provide leadership, direction, and technical oversight for the Electrical Engineering team across new product development, sustaining engineering, and operational support activities. * Manage electrical engineering resources, priorities, workload, and deliverables across multiple power generation product lines and projects. * Lead the development, review, and approval of electrical designs, including single line diagrams, schematics, wiring diagrams, cable schedules, electrical layouts, grounding systems, protection systems, and associated engineering documentation. * Ensure electrical systems and designs comply with applicable codes, standards, customer requirements, engineering specifications, and company design practices. * Establish and maintain electrical engineering standards, design guidelines, specifications, calculation methods, and standardized engineering processes. * Provide technical oversight of power distribution, generation, protection and control, grounding, auxiliary power, motor control, and other electrical systems associated with power generation equipment. * Support electrical equipment specification, selection, and technical evaluation, including generators, transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, MCCs, protective relays, cables, and auxiliary electrical equipment. * Review and approve vendor drawings, technical submittals, calculations, and equipment documentation to ensure compliance with engineering and project requirements. * Collaborate with Mechanical, Controls, Project Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Field Operations, and external engineering partners to ensure successful integration of electrical systems into overall product designs. * Support manufacturing, assembly, testing, FAT, commissioning, and field activities by providing timely engineering direction and resolution of technical issues. * Lead electrical root cause analysis and corrective action activities associated with equipment failures, design deficiencies, and field performance issues. * Drive design improvements, standardization, cost optimization, reliability improvements, and lessons learned across the electrical product portfolio. * Participate in design reviews, technical risk assessments, and engineering change processes throughout the product lifecycle. * Develop, mentor, and provide technical guidance to Electrical Engineers while establishing clear performance expectations and supporting professional development. * Support project planning by developing engineering estimates, schedules, resource requirements, and technical execution strategies. * Ensure electrical engineering documentation, drawings, calculations, and design records are properly maintained within company document control and product lifecycle management systems. * Interface with customers, vendors, engineering partners, and other external stakeholders on electrical technical matters as required. * Communicate engineering progress, technical risks, resource constraints, and significant issues to Engineering leadership and other stakeholders. * Promote a culture of engineering ownership, technical excellence, accountability, safety, collaboration, and continuous improvement. * Performs other related duties as assigned to assist with successful operations and business continuity. **POSITION REQUIREMENTS*** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship. * Must be at least 18 years of age or older. * Overtime based on business needs. * Successfully passes all applicable general pre employment testing including but not limited to: backgr  and varying generation/load configurations. * Demonstrate strong technical leadership, problem solving, communication, and decision making skills with the ability to manage multiple engineering priorities across multidisciplinary teams. * Remain knowledgeable of and compliant with Active Learner, Paycom, KPA, and other company mandated systems. * Quickly learn and navigate company platforms. * Efficiently use Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/WORK ENVIRONMENT** The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Employees are frequently required to walk, sit, climb, bend, reach, and squat or kneel. The employee works primarily indoors and will be sitting for prolonged periods at a desk while typing on a computer, whether in a home office, corporate office, client office, or jobsite. It is expected that all employees, both management and staff, will fully support these nondiscriminatory policies.* All field and shop employees and potential employees performing or assuming roles that require exposure to industrial activities, including, but not limited to, roles in shop or field operations environments, must be able to effectively communicate and comprehend the English language. This provision does not purport to require employees to always speak only English in the workplace or otherwise prevent employees from speaking non English languages, provided that such employees are able to effectively communicate and comprehend English to satisfy the company’s expectations and business objectives. **English comprehension is necessary to ensure employees:*** Understand all health and safety communications. * Possess a sufficient level of relevant equipment knowledge. * Comprehend verbal and written communications from the company and other employees. * Comprehend all operational and safety procedures. * Understand alerts and emergency notifications, including Responses to Alerts, Warnings and Emergencies. * Understand the contents of announcements and/or radio communications. * Are able to effectively and independently communicate with customers, supervisors, and colleagues. * Are able to prevent workplace accidents and/or injuries through effective communication. The company has reviewed this job description to ensure essential functions and duties have been included. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills, and abilities. Last Revised: 08\.2026

jobs.description: **Power Generation – Controls SME** **Job Description** **Department:** Manufacturing**Job Status:** Full\-Time**FLSA Status:** Salary\-Exempt **Reports To:** SME Engineering Manager**Location:** Houston, TX (Channelview Area)**Amount of Travel Required:** Varies**Work Schedule:** Monday – Friday, 8 a.m. – 5 p.m. **Positions Supervised:** N/A**AIP Level:** 6**POSITION SUMMARY:** The Controls SME serves as the technical authority for power generation control systems across gas turbine and reciprocating engine platforms, associated auxiliary systems, and balance of plant controls. This role provides advanced expertise in controls architecture, programming, sequencing, integration, troubleshooting, and lifecycle support; supports new product development, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), commissioning, root cause analysis, and sustaining engineering; and drives the standardization of controls philosophies, programming practices, system architectures, and technical standards across the power generation portfolio.**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** (The following duties and responsibilities are all essential job functions, as defined by the ADA, except for those that begin with the word "may.")* Serve as the technical authority for power generation control systems, including gas turbines, reciprocating engines, generators, auxiliary systems, and balance of plant controls. * Provide technical expertise for turbine control platforms, including Woodward GAP/Micronet, GE Mark VIe, Siemens, Allen Bradley, and other industrial control platforms used across the power generation portfolio. * Develop, review, troubleshoot, and optimize control system software, including start/stop sequencing, permissives, interlocks, trips, alarms, fuel control, speed control, temperature control, and load control functions. * Provide technical expertise for generator synchronization, load sharing, real and reactive power control, frequency and voltage control, load shedding, and integration with Power Management Systems (PMS) and microgrid controllers. * Develop and review control system architectures, network architectures, I/O configurations, control narratives, Cause \& Effect matrices, functional descriptions, and system interface requirements. * Develop and standardize control philosophies, programming standards, software architectures, alarm philosophies, naming conventions, and engineering best practices. * Provide technical oversight for integration among turbine controls, generator controls, excitation/AVR systems, protective relays, PMS, emissions systems, auxiliary equipment, and customer control systems. * Develop and support industrial communication interfaces using Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP, PROFINET, DNP3, and other applicable industrial communication standards. * Lead complex controls troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities involving turbine trips, failed starts, control instability, communication failures, instrumentation issues, sequencing problems, and equipment performance concerns. * Analyze control system and telemetry data to identify failure mechanisms, operational trends, control system anomalies, and reliability or performance improvement opportunities. * Support the development of condition monitoring, predictive analytics, and AI based diagnostic capabilities using control system and telemetric data. * Develop and execute control system testing and validation procedures for sequencing, protection, interlocks, communications, system interfaces, and functional performance before deployment. * Support field commissioning and startup activities, including controls checkout, loop checks, first fire activities, synchronization, load testing, performance validation, and troubleshooting. * Review and technically approve vendor control system designs, software, drawings, documentation, and integration requirements for compliance with company standards and product requirements. * Collaborate with Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Product Engineering, Product Service Engineering, Remote Operations, and Field Operations on control system integration and technical issues. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to Controls Engineers, Product Service Engineers, commissioning personnel, and field teams. * Evaluate emerging control platforms, automation technologies, simulation tools, communication technologies, and OEM solutions for potential application across current and future power generation products. * Incorporate lessons learned from commissioning, field operations, failures, and root cause analysis into control standards, software libraries, and future product designs. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, training materials, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge repositories. * Interface with turbine OEMs, controls vendors, customers, engineering partners, and other technical stakeholders to resolve complex controls and system integration issues. * Promote technical excellence, nce levels. * Manage cross functional communication among engineering, operations, and field service teams. * Promote accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement. * Demonstrate strong interpersonal and leadership skills. * Efficiently use Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. * Knowledge of GE and other gas turbine related controls programs. * Successfully complete New Hire Safety Orientation and annual recertification. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/WORK ENVIRONMENT** The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Employees are frequently required to walk, sit, climb, bend, reach, and squat or kneel. The employee works primarily indoors and will be sitting for prolonged periods at a desk while typing on a computer, whether in a home office, corporate office, client office, or jobsite. The employee must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization's facilities. When required to visit a wellsite, the work environment may include exposure to hazardous materials, operating conditions, audio levels up to 85 dB, inclement weather, and extreme temperatures (both hot and cold). Given these conditions, employees visiting a pad site are required to wear company mandated and company issued Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), including fire retardant coveralls, safety hat, steel toe boots, safety glasses, ear protection, and impact gloves, and must strictly adhere to all safety policies and procedures. Employees must be able to independently lift 25 lbs. Work hours ***may include or includes*** early morning, late evenings, and weekends, depending on business necessity.**AAP /EEO STATEMENT** The Company is committed to the cause of equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, thus abiding by all applicable state and federal laws. Our practices regarding employment, job promotion, compensation, training, and termination do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religious creed, age, sex, national origin, veteran's status, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. It is expected that all employees, both management and staff, will fully support these nondiscriminatory policies. All field and shop employees and potential employees performing or assuming roles that require exposure to industrial activities, including, but not limited to, roles in shop or field operations environments, must be able to effectively communicate and comprehend the English language. This provision does not purport to require employees to always speak only English in the workplace or otherwise prevent employees from speaking non English languages, provided that such employees are able to effectively communicate and comprehend English to satisfy the company’s expectations and business objectives. **English comprehension is necessary to ensure employees:*** Understand all health and safety communications. * Possess a sufficient level of relevant equipment knowledge. * Comprehend verbal and written communications from the company and other employees. * Comprehend all operational and safety procedures. * Understand alerts and emergency notifications, including Responses to Alerts, Warnings and Emergencies. * Understand the contents of announcements and/or radio communications. * Are able to effectively and independently communicate with customers, supervisors, and colleagues. * Are able to prevent workplace accidents and/or injuries through effective communication. The company has reviewed this job description to ensure essential functions and duties have been included. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills, and abilities. Last Revised: 08\.2026

jobs.title: Senior Water Resources Engineer - Aviation
jobs.description: **Company Overview** EG Solutions, Inc. (EGS) is a consulting firm specializing in water management for Florida airports as one of our four focus areas. Airport water management includes surface water quality and quantity and groundwater interactions in an operating environment that requires innovative and non\-standard approaches to avoid hazards to aircraft operations. With more than 100 years of combined experience among senior leadership, the EGS team provides those innovative solutions to airport clients throughout Florida. EGS is headquartered in the Sarasota area of Southwest Florida. **Position Summary** The Senior Water Resources Engineer provides analysis, design, permitting, and project management support for a variety of airport water management projects. This position performs technical work that includes hydrologic and hydraulic analyses, water quality evaluations, drainage design, floodplain studies, erosion and sediment control, water quantity and quality monitoring system design and data evaluation, groundwater hydrology, permitting, and construction support. The Senior Water Resources Engineer works collaboratively with internal staff, clients, contractors, consultants, and regulatory agencies to support successful project delivery. This position requires strong technical and organizational skills, independent thinking, and the ability to effectively manage changing project priorities. Occasional fieldwork and travel are required. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: * Perform stormwater system analysis and design for airport projects, including conveyance, storage, and stormwater quality best management practices. * Perform analysis and calculations to establish water quality treatment efficiencies for non\-standard, airport operation compatible design. * Perform surface water/groundwater interaction analyses to evaluate groundwater mounds, dewatering system design, potable groundwater supply from wells and similar. * Prepare or direct technical staff preparing technical reports, construction plans and details, construction technical specifications, presentation graphics, and other technical project deliverables. * Analyze flood\-prone areas to identify problems, evaluate alternative solutions, and develop recommended design alternatives. * Design soil erosion and sediment control practices. * Prepare grading designs and conceptual site layouts for consistency with stormwater management systems. * Coordinate with engineering and technical disciplines on multidisciplinary projects. * Assist with regulatory agency coordination, communication, and permitting activities for assigned projects. * Provide technical support during bidding and construction, as required. * Manage assigned projects and ensure deliverables are completed accurately and in accordance with established schedules and deadlines. * Communicate project progress and coordinate effectively with clients, regulators, subconsultants, and other project stakeholders. * Attend and participate in project meetings. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, or a related field from an accredited four\-year college or university. * Professional Engineer (PE) licensure. * 5\+ years experience * Fundamental understanding of water resources concepts, including stormwater management, water quality and chemistry, hydraulics, fluid mechanics, hydrology, geohydrology, and permitting. * Proficiency with at least one of the following modeling programs: EPA SWMM, Storm Wise/ICPR, or HEC\-RAS. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. * Valid driver’s license. * Ability to successfully complete required background check to pass airport security badge screening. * Ability to meet company drug\-free workplace requirements. **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience working on airport projects. * Field experience with water quality and quantity monitoring, including system design. * Experience applying for Environmental Resource Permits and Consumptive Use Permits with one or more Florida Water Management Districts. * Experience providing construction phase services, including shop drawing reviews, construction evaluation, permit closeouts, and similar. * Proficiency with Geographic Information Systems (GIS). * Proficiency with AutoCAD Civil 3D. * Experience with field and laboratory testing for geohydrologic data and parameters. * Experience with Computational Fluid Dynamics. * Experience with artificial intelligence and/or machine learning applications relevant to engineering or project delivery. * Pilot experience or aviation\-related knowledge. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Strong technical and analytical skills. * Ability to define the problem requiring solution. * Ability to analyze technical problems and develop practical design alternatives. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. * Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. * Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact professionally with clients, contractors, consultants, regulatory personnel, and internal team members. * Ability to coordinate effectively with regulatory agencies and other project stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple projects, tasks, and changing priorities. * Ability to respond quickly and accurately under pressure. * Ability to meet established project schedules and deadlines. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to prepare clear and accurate technical documentation, calculations, reports, and project deliverables. * Ability to evaluate alternative approaches to project design and delivery. **Physical Requirements and Working Conditions** This position operates in a combination of office, remote, hybrid, and field environments depending on project and business needs. Occasional fieldwork at airports, construction sites, and other project locations is required. The employee must be able to: * Remain in a stationary position for extended periods while working at a computer. * Frequently use a computer, keyboard, telephone, and other standard office equipment. * Communicate effectively with employees, clients, contractors, consultants, regulatory personnel, and other project stakeholders. * Work outdoors and in active project or construction environments as required. * Occasionally move materials or equipment weighing up to 50 pounds over short distances. * Travel to airports, project sites, meetings, training, or other business\-related activities as required. * Adapt to changing priorities and business needs in a fast\-paced professional environment. **Travel Requirements** * Occasional local and regional travel is required. * Travel to airports, construction sites, client meetings, regulatory meetings, and other project locations may be required. * Additional travel requirements may vary based on project assignments and client needs. * A valid driver’s license is required. **Compensation and Benefits** Compensation: Highly competitive salary based on experience Benefits may include: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * Paid time off and company holidays. * Retirement savings plan with company contribution or match, where applicable. * Professional development and certification support. * Mileage reimbursement and travel\-related expenses in accordance with company policy. * Opportunities for advancement within a growing consulting firm. **Equal Employment Opportunity** *EG Solutions, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and maintains a drug\-free workplace. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable federal, state, or local law.* Pay: $114,000\.00 \- $156,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description: Based out of our North American headquarters in **Novi**, Michigan, this role operates on a hybrid schedule that blends in\-office collaboration with remote work flexibility . As a **Business Development Manager**, you will be responsible for identifying, cultivating, and closing new enterprise business, with a focus on our digital engineering technology stack of: **modeFRONTIER**, **VOLTA**, and our newly launched AI engineering platform, **nDAI**. This role requires a consultative sales approach, a deep understanding of the digital engineering and simulation/CAE landscape, and the ability to engage with C\-level executives, engineering directors, and CAE analysts to solve complex design and data governance challenges. #### **Core Responsibilities** * **New Business Generation:** Prospect, qualify, and close new enterprise accounts across North America, meeting or exceeding annual software licensing revenue targets. * **Strategic Pipeline Development:** Build and manage a robust sales pipeline through outbound prospecting, industry networking, targeted campaigns, and collaboration with the marketing team. * **Consultative Solution Selling:** Lead complex sales cycles by understanding customer engineering workflows, identifying bottlenecks, and positioning ESTECO’s software stack as the premium solution for design optimization, SPDM (Simulation Process and Data Management), and AI\-driven engineering. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with Application Engineers and Pre\-Sales Technical teams to orchestrate proof\-of\-concept (PoC) engagements, technical demonstrations, and customized solution architectures. #### **The ideal candidate will have :** * **Education:** Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering. (A background in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering paired with sales experience is highly preferred). * **Experience:** 5\+ years of quota\-carrying B2B simulation/CAE software sales or business development experience. * **Domain Expertise:** Proven track record selling complex engineering software, preferably in CAE (Computer\-Aided Engineering), SPDM, or industrial AI/ML solutions. * **Sales Acumen:** Demonstrated ability to navigate 6\-to\-12\-month sales cycles, manage multiple stakeholders in a technical sale, and consistently achieve six\-to\-seven\-figure revenue quotas. * **Communication:** Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills. Ability to translate highly technical concepts into distinct business value and ROI. * **Travel:** Willingness to travel up to 40% across North America for client meetings and industry conferences. #### **Perks and benefits** **️ ️** **:** * Medical, dental, vision and LTD Insurances * Flex/Dependent Care Savings Accounts * 401k * Compensation: this role features a compensation structure consisting of a competitive base salary alongside variable earnings based on sales commissions * Flexible working\-hours * Paid time off * International experience * Friendly work environment * Internal and external training #### **About ESTECO** ESTECO was founded in 1999 and is a pioneer in numerical optimization solutions, specialized in research and development of multidisciplinary design optimization software technology. Advanced simulation has become a standard resource for product development in today’s business world. With the continuous demand for cost savings and shorter time to market, only the most sophisticated tools allow companies to stay competitive. In an increasingly complex design process, it is essential for engineers and R\&D teams to adopt a multidisciplinary design approach, incorporating large numbers of variables, objectives, and iterations to obtain a full understanding of the overall design space and system performance. ESTECO aims to decrease the tedium in engineering analysis and increase creativity by developing cutting\-edge software that allows for simulation process integration, collaboration, optimization, machine learning and advanced data analysis. Over 300 international organizations have entrusted ESTECO's software to design better and more efficient products across a wide spectrum of industrial sectors. In North America we have a wide variety of clients we work with like FORD, Lockheed Martin, Raytheon, General Atomics, Schlumberger, Wilson Sports and many more. #### **About modeFRONTIER** modeFRONTIER is an integration platform for multi\-objective and multidisciplinary optimization. It provides a seamless coupling with third party engineering tools, enables the automation of the design simulation process, and facilitates analytic decision making. The software’s powerful workflow allows the execution of complex chains of design processes, while innovative optimization and machine learning algorithms determine the best set of possible solutions combining opposing objectives, and post\-processing tools allow the user to perform sophisticated statistical analysis, data visualization and decision making. #### **About VOLTA** VOLTA is a web\-based distributed execution framework for managing collaborative design processes. VOLTA extends the familiar modeFRONTIER desktop paradigm to a web\-based collaborative environment and empowers design teams with a sharing platform for models, workflows, simulations, optimization data and results. #### **About nDAI** nDAI provides a robust data governance framework that gives engineering teams fine\-grained control over how to train and use AI for engineering simulation design. Ensure full traceability of training data and version control of every trained model.

jobs.title: Director of business systems & AI
jobs.description: Director of Business Systems \& AI Eclipse Lighting \& ElectricalLocation: Southern CaliforniaJob Type: Full\-TimeCompensation: $150,000–$190,000 per year \+ performance bonus About Eclipse Lighting \& Electrical Eclipse Lighting \& Electrical is an established commercial lighting and electrical contractor with approximately 100 employees. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a highly capable Director of Business Systems \& AI to lead a company\-wide transformation of our processes, technology, automation, data, and use of artificial intelligence. This is not a traditional IT support position, and we are not looking for someone simply to introduce employees to AI tools. We are looking for someone who can learn how our business operates from the ground up, identify inefficient or outdated processes, and then design and implement better systems. The Opportunity Our company has grown significantly over the years, and some of our processes and systems have not evolved as quickly as the business. Many workflows currently involve combinations of paper, manual approvals, multiple software systems, databases, spreadsheets, and repeated data entry. We believe there is a significant opportunity to use modern software, automation, integrations, data analytics, and AI to fundamentally improve how the company operates. You will be responsible for leading that transformation. You will work directly with company ownership and department leaders across: * Operations * Dispatch * Field Operations * Estimating * Engineering * Sales * Accounting * Accounts Receivable * Accounts Payable * Payroll * Purchasing * Billing * Human Resources * IT Your job will be to understand how work actually moves through Eclipse and determine how we can do it better. What You’ll Do Understand and Redesign Our Processes Spend time inside each department observing how employees actually work. Map workflows from initial customer request through estimating, scheduling, field execution, documentation, billing, collection, and financial reporting. Identify: * Duplicate data entry * Unnecessary approvals * Paper\-based processes * Manual reporting * Bottlenecks * Disconnected systems * Repetitive administrative work * Opportunities for automation * Opportunities for AI * Processes that should be redesigned before they are automated We don’t want to automate bad processes. We want to fix them first. Own Our Business Systems Strategy Evaluate our existing technology stack and determine what should be kept, improved, integrated, replaced, or eliminated. Current systems include QuickBooks Enterprise, Microsoft Access\-based operational systems, custom\-developed applications, and various department\-specific tools and processes. You will help determine the appropriate long\-term technology architecture for the company. Implement Automation and AI Identify practical applications of AI and automation that produce measurable business results. Potential applications include: * Automated document processing * Work\-order processing * Dispatch and scheduling assistance * Estimating and takeoff automation * Field documentation * Purchasing and material workflows * Invoice preparation and validation * Accounts receivable workflows * Job\-cost analysis * Financial reporting * Management dashboards * Customer communication * Internal knowledge systems * Contract and document review * Exception detection * Operational analytics AI should solve business problems—not be implemented simply because it is new technology. Connect Our Systems Reduce information silos and unnecessary manual entry. Develop or oversee integrations between accounting, operations, estimating, field systems, reporting tools, and other company platforms. Experience with APIs, databases, workflow automation, and systems integration is highly valuable. Build Management Visibility Create systems and dashboards that allow leadership to quickly understand: * Job profitability * Labor performance * Billing status * Accounts receivable * Operational bottlenecks * Estimating performance * Field productivity * Purchasing/material issues * Financial performance * Exceptions requiring management attention Our goal is to move from searching for information to having important information automatically surfaced to management. Lead Implementation You will not necessarily be expected to personally write every piece of software. You will be expected to understand technology well enough to determine what should be built, purchased, or integrated and to manage internal resources, developers, consultants, vendors, and AI platforms required to accomplish it. Most importantly, you will be accountable for getting projects implemented—not simply making recommendations. What We’re Looking For The ideal candidate has experience in some combination of: * Construction technology * Electrical, mechanical, plumbing, or specialty contracting * Business systems * ERP implementation * Digital transformation * Operations/process improvement * Systems integration * Workflow automation * AI implementation * Data analytics Experience inside a commercial contractor or construction company is strongly preferred. You should understand—or be capable of quickly understanding—business processes involving: * Estimating * Project/service operations * Dispatch * Purchasing * Field labor * Payroll * Job costing * Billing * Accounts receivable * Accounting Technical Experience Experience with some combination of the following is preferred: * Construction ERP systems * QuickBooks Enterprise or similar accounting/ERP platforms * Microsoft SQL Server / SQL * Microsoft Access * Power BI * Microsoft Power Platform * APIs and system integrations * Workflow automation platforms * Cloud applications * AI/LLM platforms * AI agents and workflow automation * Data architecture and reporting * Construction management software You do not need experience with every technology listed above. We care more about your ability to understand business problems, design solutions, and successfully implement them. Who Will Succeed in This Position You may be a strong fit if you are the type of person who walks into a department, watches a process involving 15 steps and immediately starts asking: Why are we doing it this way? You enjoy understanding how businesses actually operate. You are comfortable talking with everyone from electricians and dispatchers to accountants, engineers, managers, software developers, and company ownership. You can translate operational problems into technology solutions. You aren’t afraid to challenge existing processes. And you finish what you start. What This Position Is NOT This is not primarily: * Help desk/desktop support * Network administration * Cybersecurity * Software development * An AI research position * A consulting position that produces reports without implementation This is a hands\-on leadership position responsible for making Eclipse a more efficient, scalable, data\-driven company. How Success Will Be Measured Success will be measured by tangible improvements such as: * Reduction in manual administrative work * Faster work\-order\-to\-invoice cycle * Reduced duplicate data entry * Improved billing accuracy * Better job\-cost visibility * Improved estimating throughput * Faster management reporting * Improved accounts receivable processes * Reduced dependence on paper * Successful adoption of new systems across the organization Why Join Eclipse? This is a rare opportunity to have significant influence over the future of an established company. You will not be joining a massive corporate IT department where you own one small piece of a system. You will have direct access to company ownership and the ability to rethink how an entire organization operates. For the right person, this is an opportunity to build the technology and operational infrastructure that will support Eclipse’s next stage of growth. Compensation: $150,000–$190,000 annually, depending on experience, plus performance\-based bonus. Job Type: Full\-time Work Location: Southern California / On\-site Because understanding our field and office operations is critical to this position, this is primarily an on\-site role. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $190,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

Through EverlifeMD.com, we are scaling rapidly across the U.S. with strong in\-house technology, automation, marketing, customer service, and creative infrastructure. We have earned a \*\*4\.9 Trustpilot rating with 2,500\+ reviews\*\* and are continuing to scale aggressively. We are a fast\-moving longevity company looking for people who want to grow with us, wear multiple hats, move quickly, and stay on the cutting edge of both health and technology. **The Role** Everlife is looking for an \*\*exceptionally strong AI Optimization \& Automation Specialist\*\* to work directly with our Founders and CTO. We already have substantial infrastructure in place. Your role is to \*\*plug into that infrastructure, identify where AI can create leverage, design better workflows, connect tools and platforms, and continuously optimize how the company operates.\*\* You do not need to be a traditional software engineer. You should be comfortable with concepts such as: \* APIs \* Webhooks \* API documentation \* JSON \* Databases \* SaaS integrations \* Authentication \* Workflow logic \* Data flow between systems \* Automation platforms \* Basic scripting or technical prototyping \* Cloud\-based tools \* Error handling and monitoring You should be capable of understanding how systems connect, designing the workflow, testing integrations, and clearly communicating technical requirements to engineers when deeper development is needed. \#\# Systems We Work With Experience with any of the following is valuable: \* Zendesk \* Klaviyo \* QuickBooks \* CRMs \* Meta \* Higgsfield \* ElevenLabs \* Claude \* OpenAI \* Gemini \* Grok \* Supabase \* Cloudflare You do not need to be an expert in every platform. You need to be exceptionally good at \*\*learning new tools quickly and figuring out how to use them together.\*\* \#\# Who We're Looking For We're looking for a \*\*high\-agency, hungry AI operator and optimizer\*\*. You should constantly be asking: \*\*Can AI do this better? Can this be automated? Can these systems be connected? Can we reduce human work? Can we improve quality or speed? Can we use a better model or tool?\*\* You should be comfortable moving between departments and solving very different problems. One day you may be improving an AI creative workflow. The next day you may be redesigning Zendesk automation. Then working with the CTO on a QuickBooks or CRM integration. You should move quickly from: \*\*Problem → AI Solution → Workflow → Test → Optimize → Scale\*\* We care much more about \*\*what you've built, how you think, and how quickly you learn\*\* than traditional credentials. \#\# You're Probably a Great Fit If \* You're obsessed with AI and automation \* You test new AI tools constantly \* You have strong experience with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok \* You understand APIs and system integrations \* You're familiar with CRMs and SaaS tools \* You understand creative AI and tools like Higgsfield \* You're comfortable with Zendesk, Klaviyo, QuickBooks, or similar platforms \* You think in workflows and systems \* You are highly analytical and optimization\-focused \* You can work effectively with technical engineers without needing to be one \* You move extremely fast \* You like wearing multiple hats \* You want to grow inside a rapidly scaling company \#\# Not a Fit If \* Your AI experience is limited to writing prompts \* You only know one AI platform \* You aren't comfortable with APIs or technical workflows \* You need detailed instructions before getting started \* You don't experiment with new tools \* You prefer narrow roles and fixed responsibilities \* You don't think in terms of optimization \* You move slowly \#\# Compensation \*\*$135,000–$165,000 base \+ meaningful performance bonus.\*\* For an exceptional candidate, we are flexible. \#\# How to Apply Don't just send a résumé. \*\*Show us what you've built or optimized.\*\* Send examples of: \* AI workflows \* Automations \* Agents \* Creative AI systems \* API\-driven projects \* CRM or lifecycle automation \* Zendesk workflows \* Klaviyo systems \* QuickBooks or operations automation \* Multi\-model AI workflows \* Demos \* Loom walkthroughs \* Personal projects We would rather see a smart system you built or optimized than another certification. If you're obsessed with AI, relentlessly focused on optimization, technically fluent, move fast, and want to work directly with Everlife's Founders and CTO improving AI across the entire company—we want to meet you. Pay: $140,000\.00 \- $185,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Production Cloud and Container Services
jobs.description: Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end\-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue. We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us. **Posting Open Date: Sept. 25, 2026** **Anticipated Posting Close Date\*: Oct. 23, 2026** * *Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.* **Senior Engineer \- Production Cloud and Container Services** Fleet Operations and Production Engineering at Fastly is looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Cloud and Container Services team. This role is focused on helping to scale and manage Fastly’s Kubernetes based platform for control plane services. This platform is built on top of multiple public cloud services and contains many Kubernetes ecosystem components. We’re working to scale out our platform to support growth and at the same time evolve to address new business priorities. A successful candidate will help expand our platform feature set, support existing users and onboard new services, and drive efficiency while maintaining a secure platform. **What You'll Do:** * Design, build, and operate infrastructure (cloud, Fastly datacenter) to enable reliable and rapid deployment. This includes effective monitoring and resilient operations in a large\-scale multi\-cloud and hybrid cloud / on\-premise environment. The majority of workloads are containerized but some are using native cloud services such as compute and storage. * Diagnose and resolve performance and reliability issues across the stack: application, operating system, network, 3rd party services and APIs, including cross\-application dependencies. * Deploy and support complex 3rd party and internally developed applications. * Write tools to automate maintenance and deployment of servers, services, and applications. * Collaborate with internal users and continually evolve the platform and its operations using solid engineering practices. * Drive projects sometimes independently and sometimes collaboratively across time zones. * Configure access and manage operations within a multi\-cloud environment. **What We're Looking For:** * Experience running high availability systems and supporting distributed infrastructure. Most Senior level Engineers at Fastly have more than 5 years of related experience. * + You have designed services with fault tolerance and across geographies. + You have deployed and managed multi\-tiered services. * Understanding of Linux systems, high and low level. You have used tcpdump and tracing tools. * Experience building and operating production\-grade kubernetes clusters in multiple regions, clouds or data centers. You have experience with tooling in the CNCF space, such as: prometheus, flux, helm, etc. * Experience with programming languages such as Go and Python. You can read code and reason about what it does. You can write code within an existing large code base such as adding features. You can create medium\-sized programs from scratch such as custom kubernetes controllers, custom prometheus exporters, and building tooling to help manage infrastructure. * Experience with infrastructure and configuration management tooling. You have used Terraform to manage infrastructure. * Experience provisioning and managing users and resources with cloud providers such as AWS and GCP. You have provisioned users and accounts using both graphical user interfaces and infrastructure as code frameworks. You have experience provisioning components on public cloud and understand how they work together in creating a multi\-tiered service. You have deployed and managed services built on top of public cloud components such as EC2, S3, and GKE. * Experience with CI/CD and GitOps tooling. You can iterate infrastructure via pipelines through code changes. You have experience using Github including creating and reviewing pull requests. * Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Datadog and Grafana. * Experience working on a distributed team. You have experience collaborating across timezones. You can articulate challenges of distributed teams and how you mitigate them. * Experience leveraging AI tooling to accelerate your work and enable new capabilities. You have used tooling like Claude Code and created skills or agents with demonstrated success in unlocking you, your team, and/or the company to achieve more. **Work Hours:** * This position will require you to be available during core business hours and occasional nights and weekends as necessary to support on\-call coverage. **Work Location(s) \& Trav he US is $181,220 to $217,464\. Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and location. This role may be eligible to participate in Fastly’s equity and discretionary bonus programs. **Benefits:** We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings? In the US, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Family planning, mental health support along with Employee Assistance Program, Insurance (Life, Disability, and Accident), a Flexible Vacation policy and up to 18 days of accrued paid sick leave are there to help support our employees. We also offer 401(k) (including company match) and an Employee Stock Purchase Program. For 2026, we offer 11 paid local holidays, 12 paid company wellness days. **Why Fastly?** * **We have a huge impact.** Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives. Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand. * **We value diversity.** Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful \- every day. * **We are passionate.** Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about. **We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply!** **A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying.** *All job applications must be submitted through our official careers site at* *www.fastly.com/about/careers**. We will never request sensitive information, such as your Social Security number, bank account or credit card information during the application process. All official communication will come from an @**fastly.com* *or @**recruiting.fastly.com* *email address.* *Fastly is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity and to providing employees with a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Our employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications.* *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, family or parental status, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.* *Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and federal or state disability laws, Fastly will provide reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact your Recruiter, or the Fastly Employee Relations team at* *candidateaccommodations@fastly.com* *or 501\-287\-4901\.* *Fastly collects and processes personal data submitted by job applicants in accordance with our* *Privacy Policy**. Please see our* *privacy notice for job applicants**.*

jobs.title: Senior Sales Recruiter
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. **Location:** Remote (U.S.) \| **Travel:** 0–10% **The Role** At MISUMI Americas, we're hiring a Senior Sales Recruiter to own full\-cycle sales hiring in the U.S. You'll be the person hiring managers come to before a role is even fully defined — someone who can turn a vague headcount request into a sharp candidate profile, build a real pipeline against it, and close strong candidates without losing the plot on candidate experience along the way. You will report to the Global Talent Acquisition Manager. **What You'll Do** * **Own full\-cycle recruiting for sales roles spanning individual contributor to senior management.** This includes sourcing, screening, interview coordination, stakeholder alignment, and offer negotiation. * **Build talent maps and source proactively.** Use LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, and outreach strategies tailored to each function — not a one\-size\-fits\-all script. * **Lead intake meetings that actually shape the search.** Define the candidate profile, advise hiring managers on where to flex and where not to, and keep them aligned as the process moves. * **Keep pipelines warm ahead of need.** Ongoing outreach and relationship\-building across functions, not just reacting to open reqs. * **Own the candidate journey.** From first outreach through onboarding, representing the company authentically at every touchpoint. * **Track and act on recruiting metrics.** Time\-to\-fill, pipeline health, conversion rates, source effectiveness — and use that data to actually change how you recruit, not just report on it. * **Find and fix the friction.** In interview processes and workflows, so hiring stays fast without cutting corners on quality. * **Partner cross\-functionally.** Work with People Operations and leadership on hiring priorities and workforce planning. * All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS. **What You'll Bring** **Experience** * Minimum of 5–7 years of full\-cycle sales recruiting or talent acquisition * Track record in fast\-paced, high\-growth, or startup environments preferred * Proven ability to run multiple diverse requisitions at once, without one function's hiring stalling because another one's on fire **Technical Skills** * Greenhouse ATS or a comparable system, including structured interview processes and reporting * Strong hands\-on proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools * Working knowledge of U.S. talent markets, compensation trends, and hiring norms across the functions above * Fluent with AI tools in the recruiting workflow — sourcing, screening, drafting outreach, and surfacing insights from pipeline data — and knows where to apply judgment instead of automation **Soft Skills \& Attributes** * Stakeholder management that goes beyond scheduling — able to actually influence a hiring manager's decision when the data says something different than their gut * Candidate\-first mindset, with an inclusive process as the default, not an afterthought * Organized enough to juggle competing searches without dropping any of them * Analytical — comfortable using data to drive decisions, not just to build a slide * Adaptable, and genuinely energized by variety rather than worn down by it **Work Environment** Remote position; standard computer\-based work with extended periods of sitting. Reasonable accommodations are available for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role. Travel expectations for this role are 0–10%. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) plan * Paid parental leave * Paid volunteer days * And more **Salary Range** $95,000 – $120,000 per year, depending on experience We're actively seeking teammates who: * Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. * Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. * Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. * Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. * Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.
