jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Fieldpiece** is a privately held, global leader in professional HVACR tools and test instruments. We're known for developing innovative products that technicians rely on every day \- and for investing in our people, our technology, and our future. Named***one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California for four consecutive years***, we're looking for talented people who want to make an impact while growing their careers. We're looking for a **Senior AI Engineer** to help us turn the potential of AI into practical solutions that help teams to increase their efficiency, speed, and accuracy in their everyday jobs. This is a unique opportunity to become our first dedicated AI engineering hire and help shape how AI and automation are used across the organization. You'll partner with teams throughout the business—from Sales, Marketing, Finance, and HR to Product Development, Supply Chain, Operations, Customer Experience, and IT—to understand how they work, identify opportunities for improvement, and build solutions that deliver measurable value. This position is in our Orange, CA office with an exciting move to Tustin, CA in 2028\. This role follows a hybrid work schedule, with employees typically working onsite three days per week. Additional in\-office days may be required from time to time for onboarding, training, team meetings, project collaboration, or other business needs.**Why This Role?*** This isn't a role where you'll spend your time simply evaluating AI tools or developing proofs of concept that never make it into production. You'll sit down with business teams, understand what they're trying to accomplish and where their processes are slowing them down, translate those needs into technical requirements, determine the right solution, and then build, deploy, and improve it. * The projects will vary widely. One may involve automating a manual workflow; another could involve creating an AI agent, improving access to company knowledge, connecting AI to an enterprise system, or building a decision\-support application. The common thread is using technology to solve meaningful business problems. * We're technology agnostic and want someone who can choose the right solution for the problem rather than force every problem into the same technology stack. That said, experience within the Microsoft ecosystem—particularly Dynamics 365 Business Central, Azure, Copilot, Power Platform, Fabric, Dataverse, and Microsoft 365—is highly valuable in our environment. **What You'll Do*** Partner with teams across Fieldpiece to understand their workflows, pain points, and business needs and identify opportunities where AI, automation, or better technology can make a meaningful difference. * Take business requirements from concept to solution—designing, developing, implementing, and supporting production\-ready applications and automations. * Build AI agents, copilots, workflow automations, decision\-support tools, and other practical AI\-enabled solutions. * Develop applications using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise knowledge systems, APIs, and agentic workflows. * Connect AI solutions with ERP, CRM, PLM, customer support, analytics, knowledge management, productivity, and other enterprise platforms. * Reengineer processes to improve speed, accuracy, quality, service, cost, revenue enablement, and employee productivity. * Establish testing and evaluation approaches to ensure solutions are accurate, reliable, secure, scalable, and effective. * Work closely with Information Systems, business leaders, data owners, and security stakeholders to implement appropriate governance and controls. * Help users successfully adopt new AI tools and continuously improve solutions based on feedback and results. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and make practical recommendations based on business value, implementation requirements, cost, risk, and scalability. * Bachelor’s degree in CS, AI, or related fields. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production applications. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building solutions using modern AI technologies, including large language models. * Experience taking ambiguous business problems and translating them into practical technical solutions. * Hands\-on experience with prompt design, retrieval architectures, AI application testing, and model/system evaluation. Experience building AI agents, multi\-agent systems, tool\-using agents, RAG solutions, or complex agentic workflows. * Experience integrating APIs, cloud services, enterprise applications, and data sources. * Strong proficiency in Python or another modern language used for AI application development. * Experience with data engineering, analytics, BI, MLOps/LLMOps, observability, or cloud deployment. * Experience with source control, testing, deployment, monitoring, and modern software delivery practices. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to work directly with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders and explain complex technical decisions in business terms. * A practical, curious mindset \- you enjoy learning how a business works, asking the right questions, and figuring out how technology can make it better. **Even Better If You Have*** Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or integrating solutions with ERP systems, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Fabric, or Dataverse. * Experience working in a product, manufacturing, distribution, or field\-service environment. * Exposure to Lean, continuous improvement, or business process reengineering. **Why You'll Enjoy Working at Fieldpiece*** As a privately held company, we invest for the long term—in our people, our products, and our future. That means we can focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and building lasting careers rather than chasing short\-term results. * Make a meaningful impact with a company where your ideas are heard, your expertise is valued, and your contributions help shape the future of our products and business. **Benefits \& Perks**We believe great work starts with supporting our employees. That's why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to promote your health, financial well\-being, work\-life balance, and professional growth.* Competitive base salary with annual bonus opportunity * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting * Generous paid time off and paid holidays * Hire to Retire philosophy \- Individual Development Plans for everyone and a commitment to support career development * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Health Savings Accounts (HSA), and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Music program – music rooms in all US offices with onsite guitar, piano, and voice lessons in California (classes can be streamed for other offices) * Recognition programs, launch parties and team building events to share successes **Our Culture** At Fieldpiece, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers every day. We believe in:* **Teamwork** – We collaborate, support one another, and win as a team. * **Urgency** – We move quickly, stay agile, and focus on what matters most. * **Respect** – We value diverse perspectives and treat everyone with professionalism and integrity. * **Trust** – We build strong relationships through accountability and transparency. * **Learning** – We embrace curiosity, continuous improvement, and personal growth. * **No Ego –** We leave titles and egos at the door, value the best ideas regardless of where they come from, and work together with humility, openness, and mutual respect. At Fieldpiece, we're building more than innovative products \- we're building careers. If you're looking for a place where your work matters and your contributions are recognized, we'd love to meet you. *EOE AA M/F/Veteran/Disability*

The organization operates with a lean, entrepreneurial team and emphasizes accountability, integrity, transparency, quality, and dependable execution. Team members are expected to take ownership of their work, make sound decisions without always having complete information, solve problems independently, and collaborate effectively with clients, subcontractors, vendors, design professionals, project personnel, and internal leadership. **Opportunity for Impact** We are seeking a Commercial Construction Project Manager to lead multiple projects from preconstruction through construction, financial administration, and final closeout. This position combines project leadership, financial management, procurement, stakeholder communication, and operational process development. The successful candidate will have meaningful experience managing both ground\-up commercial construction and renovation projects, generally valued at approximately $500,000 to $10 million. improvements \- Support the development of junior project managers and project personnel **Role \& Responsibilities** \- Oversee all phases of commercial construction projects from preconstruction specifications \- Collaborate with architects, engineers, clients, inspectors, and other stakeholders to align expectations and address project challenges \- Conduct jobsite and trade\-completion inspections to verify progress, craftsmanship, approved methods, and compliance with plans and specifications \- Participate in municipal, fire, and other required inspections and communicate professionally with authorities having jurisdiction \- Coordinate with superintendents to ensure daily logs, current plans, schedule updates,  and technology platforms quickly \- Degree in construction management, engineering, or a related discipline strongly preferred; exceptional equivalent experience may be considered \- PMP certification preferred but not required \- OSHA 30 certification and a comprehensive understanding of construction safety requirements \- Experience developing construction processes and operational improvements preferred \- Evidence of progressive career advancement and readiness to independently own the complete project lifecycle **Personal Attributes** \- Highly accountable and committed to dependable execution \- Self\-directed and effective with limited day\-to\-day supervision \- Able to understand the larger objective and determine appropriate next steps independently \- Decisive and comfortable acting with incomplete information when circumstances require it \- Careful and precise when making decisions involving scope, contracts, budgets, or project financials \- Comfortable balancing multiple active projects and competing priorities \- Willing to take direct ownership of detailed project, financial, and administrative work \- Comfortable with professional disagreement, negotiation, and holding subcontractors and team members accountable \- Assertive without being unnecessarily confrontational or damaging important working relationships \- Strong commitment to safety, craftsmanship, integrity, and quality \- Clear and proactive communicator who can represent the company effectively with clients and external stakeholders \- Resourceful and capable of navigating ambiguity in a growing organization \- Adaptable and receptive to changing responsibilities, systems, and processes \- Able to recognize mistakes, communicate them promptly, mitigate their effects, and apply what was learned \- Collaborative leader who establishes expectations, holds teams accountable, asks for help when necessary, and supports others \- Strategic thinker with an interest in improving processes and supporting organizational growth \- Interested in assuming increasing responsibility and potentially advancing into operations leadership \- Comfortable working in a lean, performance\-driven environment **Benefits \& Compensation** \- Full\-time, in\-person position based in Conroe, Texas, north of Houston \- Typical work schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. \- Local travel to Houston\-area jobs.title: Systems Engineer II

Independently executes engineering assignments and contributes to the planning and implementation of technical projects. Analyzes product and process issues, develops and evaluates solutions, and applies engineering principles to improve system performance, reliability, maintainability, and manufacturability. Collaborates across functions and serves as a technical resource within assigned areas of responsibility. **Company Overview** -------------------- At FUJIFILM Dimatix Inc., printing and material deposition devices are only as good as their printheads. We are a recognized leader in the manufacturing and design of durable and productive drop\-on\-demand inkjet printheads that power cutting\-edge systems, as well as integrated inkjet solutions that add digital inkjet capabilities to other equipment. These are part of the digitization and transformation of many applications such as commercial printing, graphics, label \& packaging, additive manufacturing, ceramic tiles, textiles, electronics and life science research. At FUJIFILM Dimatix, every product we make begins with the extraordinary people behind it. Join us for groundbreaking work in a flexible, engaging environment. We’re based in two incredible locations: Lebanon, New Hampshire, surrounded by picturesque New England landscapes, and Santa Clara, California, a dynamic hub in Silicon Valley with a mix of innovation, diversity, and sunshine. Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers **Job Description** ------------------- **KNOWLEDGE** A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization; resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career\-oriented, journey\-level position. **JOB COMPLEXITY** Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise. **SUPERVISION** Normally receives general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments. **EXPERIENCE** Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 5 years of related experience; or an advanced degree with 3 years experience; or equivalent work experience. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Design of hardware and software control systems. jobs.title: Engineering Manager 1
jobs.description: GAI Consultants, Inc. is seeking for a technically diversified Civil/Geotechnical Engineering Manager 1 to support our Power Generation Geotechnical Engineering Group working in Richmond, VA office. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Austin TX IT Innovation Center 3\-4 days per week (T\-W\-Th) **Who We Are** We are the Brands \& Marketing Software Engineering Team within the Digital Products Engineering (DPE) organization at GM. Our team collaborates closely with marketing leaders from across GM to build easy\-to\-use tooling that powers engaging and innovative customer experiences at scale — including AI\-powered discovery and search experiences — while providing meaningful value to our customers through a seamless customer journey. Our mission is to rapidly and relentlessly ideate, iterate, and launch the next generation of innovative solutions to connect GM with current and future customers, increasingly leveraging Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Vertex AI Search to deliver intelligent, personalized digital experiences. Our team comprises industry\-leading software and quality engineers, who utilize a variety of innovative development methodologies and technologies to achieve breakthrough results, drive innovation, and delight customers. **The Role** We are looking for an exceptional Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack Web) who is excited about building high\-impact web products across General Motors and designing intelligent search and discovery capabilities on Google Cloud Platform using Vertex AI Search. You will be responsible for helping lead our engineering efforts across planning, design and architecture, execution, and ramp — with a particular emphasis on: * Building modern web applications that integrate with GCP\-native services * Designing and implementing AI\-powered search experiences leveraging Vertex AI Search * Collaborating with product, marketing, and data/ML partners to experiment, measure, and continuously improve search relevance and customer engagement As a technical leader on the team, you will mentor less experienced engineers, build strong relationships with technical leaders on other teams, and help evolve our engineering culture and best practices. * **What You’ll Do** * Develop competency across our complete web technologies stack (client, framework, and services). * Produce high quality software that is unit tested, reviewed, and checked in regularly for continuous integration and deployment. * Serve as a tech lead, actively mentoring other engineers on the team and helping drive technical decisions and tradeoffs. * Investigate and resolve performance bottlenecks across the full stack, including browser, edge, and cloud services. * Lead efforts to automate testing, quality gates, and delivery pipelines, with a strong focus on reliability and observability. * Work on API, Content Management, edge, and cloud systems that power GM brand and marketing experiences. jobs.title: Soils Laboratory Technician
jobs.description: **Job description** **GESTRA Engineering, Inc.** is seeking a detail\-oriented **Soils Laboratory Technician** to join our materials testing team. In this role, you will assist our lab, focusing on the precision testing of soil and aggregate samples. Your work will provide the critical data our engineers need to ensure the structural integrity of foundations and infrastructure projects throughout the region. **The Role** As a Soils Laboratory Technician, you will be responsible for processing samples collected from construction sites and performing standardized tests in a controlled laboratory environment. You will work with specialized equipment to determine the physical and engineering properties of materials, ensuring all results meet strict **ASTM and AASHTO** requirements. **Schedule:** Typically Monday–Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, with occasional overtime based on project volume. **Key Responsibilities** * **Laboratory Testing:** Conduct routine to complex tests including Proctor density (moisture\-density relationship), sieve analysis (gradation), Atterberg limits, and moisture content. * **Sample Management:** Receive, log, and organize soil and aggregate samples from the field; ensure proper storage and disposal protocols are followed. * **Data Analysis:** Accurately calculate and record test results using specialized software and spreadsheets; verify data for consistency and precision. * **Equipment Calibration:** Maintain and calibrate sensitive laboratory instruments, such as scales, ovens, and mechanical shakers, to ensure accurate readings. * **Quality Control:** Strictly adhere to laboratory quality manuals and industry standards to maintain the firm’s laboratory accreditation. * **Collaboration:** Work closely with Project Managers and Field Technicians to communicate test results and ensure project deadlines are met. **Requirements \& Qualifications** * **Experience:** 1\+ years of experience in a laboratory or construction materials testing environment is preferred, but we are willing to train candidates with strong technical aptitude. * **Education:** High school diploma or equivalent; coursework in math or science is a plus. * **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in basic mathematical computations and data entry; experience with Microsoft Excel and Word is highly valued. * **Physical Demands:** Ability to lift and move sample bags or buckets weighing up to 50 lbs. and stand for extended periods while processing materials. * **Detail\-Oriented:** Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to follow complex, multi\-step testing procedures without deviation. * **Compliance:** Must pass a pre\-employment drug screening. **Certifications \& Preferences** * **Preferred Certifications:** * NICET Level I or II in Geotechnical/Construction Materials Testing. * WisDOT HTCP Certifications (such as Aggregate Technician \- AGGTEC\-I). * ACI Laboratory Testing Technician certifications. * **Skills:** Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple testing priorities simultaneously. **Why Join Us?** * **Professional Growth:** We provide the training and resources necessary for you to obtain industry\-recognized certifications and advance within the firm. * **Modern Laboratory:** Work in a structured environment with professional\-grade equipment and standardized processes. * **Stability:** Enjoy a consistent indoor work schedule and a collaborative team atmosphere. * **Technical Impact:** Your precision in the lab directly contributes to the safety and success of major engineering projects. Pay: $20\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Core Data Protection
jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; San Jose, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role. * 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc). * Experience integrating generative AI tools or Large Language Model (LLM) interfaces into workflows. * Experience with data governance, privacy\-by\-design principles, and compliance in enterprise data environments. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in a technology or business related field. * 7 years of experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, finance, and other stakeholders to architect and scale mission\-critical platform services. * 5 years of experience in software development or engineering involving large\-scale data infrastructure (e.g., data warehousing, data lakes, distributed query engines). * 5 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership. * Experience with modern AI/ML systems, including LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. **About the job** ----------------- At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development. One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. As the Data Protection Pillar Strategic Lead, you will shape the strategy and execution for the platform and architecture of data protection throughout Google. You will lead the team in the new agentic era, tailoring existing technology to the new world and identifying gaps in our solutions. You will help the team balance existing and growing regulatory requirements with new policies as Google's products evolve. In this role, you will partner with Product and Engineering leaders inside Core and across the entire Google ecosystem. Your role requires exceptional end\-to\-end systems thinking, unifying horizontal data protection capabilities while establishing deep cohesion across major strategic initiatives.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $240000 \- $333000 (USD) \+ 25% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Drive ownership of Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) by overseeing collaboration with partner teams (e.g., engineers, Program Managers, User Experience) during product design. * Direct and manage the definition of product roadmaps. * Own development and secure buy\-in for a product vision that identifies, defines, and supports the overall product narrative and direction, achieving an outcome that is greater than the sum of its parts. * Oversee validation of market size and opportunity (e.g., user\-based, strategic opportunity, revenue). * Lead the team through defining, identifying, collecting, and tracking appropriate product or business metrics, both quantitative and qualitative for new or existing products or business ventures. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers. We are seeking an executive\-level Technical Program Manager for Data Center Capacity Delivery to oversee hyperscale data center development programs from site selection through construction, commissioning, and operational handover. In this role, you will lead multi\-gigawatt, multi\-billion\-dollar infrastructure portfolios, drive dynamic delivery schedules, manage complex AI/ML technical insertions, and establish exceptional safety and operational standards across internal cross\-functional teams and external contractor partners. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. jobs.title: Tester
jobs.description: Tester Santa Clara, California **Job Summary** --------------- **Component \& Subsystem Lab Test Technician** **Position Summary** The Component \& Subsystem Lab Test Technician is responsible for supporting engineering development, validation, failure analysis, and characterization activities for component and subsystem hardware. This role performs sample preparation, electrical, RF, optical, and subsystem testing, maintains laboratory equipment and test stations, assists with fixture fabrication and hardware debugging, and ensures accurate documentation, inventory control, and operational readiness of the lab environment. This position requires strong hands\-on technical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to support engineering teams through product development, validation testing, and laboratory operations. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Key Responsibilities** **Sample Preparation \& Hardware Support** * Perform sample preparation activities including: * + Wafer dicing + Die extraction + Die mounting + Wire bonding + Evaluation Board (EVB) assembly and preparation * Assemble, modify, and troubleshoot laboratory hardware and test setups. * Perform soldering, rework, and debugging of simple wiring assemblies and prototypes. Support hardware station builds, maintenance, and upgrades **Skill Requirements** ---------------------- **Testing \& Characterization** * Execute repetitive and off\-shift testing activities including: * + DC electrical testing + RF testing + Optical testing + Engineering Validation Test (EVT) activities + Failure Analysis (FA) support + Subsystem characterization + Special characterization studies * Collect and document die\-level skew measurements and statistical survey data. * Ensure testing is performed according to established procedures and quality standards. * **Test Equipment \& Qualification** + Perform station qualification and capability (gage) studies. + Maintain and manage golden samples and calibration standards. + Develop and maintain test documentation, procedures, and operating instructions. + Coordinate and track calibration activities for laboratory equipment.**Data Analysis \& Reporting** + Generate EVT data rollups and summary reports using existing scripts and tools. + Review collected data for completeness and report findings to engineering teams. + Support engineers with data collection, organization, and presentation. **Other Requirements** ---------------------- **Lab Operations \& Compliance** * Maintain laboratory operational readiness and organization. * Ensure security software, operating systems, and laboratory tools remain current in accordance with IT requirements. * Follow all company safety policies and laboratory procedures. * Maintain accurate records and documentation for testing, equipment, and inventory. **Required Qualifications** * Associate degree, technical diploma, or equivalent experience in: * 2\+ years of hands\-on laboratory, manufacturing, engineering technician, or test technician experience. * Experience using electrical test equipment such as: * + Oscilloscopes + Digital multimeters + Power supplies + Signal generators + Spectrum analyzers * Basic soldering and electronic assembly skills. * Ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation. * Experience with data collection, reporting, and spreadsheet tools. * Strong organizational and inventory management skills. * Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with semiconductor, photonics, RF, or optical component testing. * Wire bonding, die attach, wafer handling, or sample preparation experience. * Familiarity with laboratory automation tools and scripting (Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or similar). * Experience supporting EVT, DVT, or failure analysis activities. * Basic machining and fixture fabrication experience. * Knowledge of calibration and measurement system analysis (Gage R\&R). * Experience with inventory management systems and BOM control. Maximum Salary (US): 86000 Minimum Salary (US): 45000

jobs.title: Forensic Structural Engineer III, Columbus, OH
jobs.description: **Forensic Structural Engineer III, Columbus, OH** At **Haag**, a Salas O’Brien company, we’ve been a trusted leader in forensic engineering and consulting since 1924, helping clients solve complex, high\-stakes problems when it matters most. We’re known for technical excellence, integrity, and clear, defensible conclusions. We’re equally committed to building a career environment where talented engineers can do their best work, grow their expertise, and make a real impact. In June2024, Haag merged with Salas O’Brien, expanding what’s possible for our team. Haag remains focused on forensic engineering, and we now offer the added strength of a broader, employee\-owned organization. This brings deeper technical resources, expanded collaboration, and more opportunities to build your career across a wide range of disciplines and industries. Founded in 1975, Salas O’Brien is an employee\-owned engineering and professional services firm focused on achieving impact for our clients, our team, and the world. We are engineered for impact, and we bring that same commitment to our people as we do to our projects. We live our values every day: Inspire, Achieve, and Connect, as shared owners of our success with a focus on a sustainable future. We work across a variety of industries providing integrated engineering and consulting services. Our specialized experience includes design for energy, manufacturing and industrial process, data centers, healthcare, science and technology, high\-rise buildings, education, and other building types as well as structural and building sciences, infrastructure asset management, advanced robotics, and more. Our technical expertise is paired with an exceptional team of business development, human resources, finance and accounting, information technology, and marketing professionals, all of whom play a key role in bringing our commitments to deliver outstanding client outcomes and build long\-term careers. **Job Summary:** We’re seeking an experienced Forensic Structural Engineer in the Columbus, OH area. In this remote/home office role, you will investigate and evaluate the cause and extent of structural damage resulting from storms, natural disasters, fires/explosions, construction/design defects, accidents, foundation movement, and more. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Forensic Investigations**: Conduct site inspections to determine the cause, origin, and extent of structural damage; evaluate failure modes and contributing factors. * **Analysis \& Reporting**: Develop clear, well\-supported conclusions and produce high\-quality technical reports, documentation, and deliverables. * **Client Communication**: Provide timely, professional updates to clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders; proactively close communication gaps and manage expectations. * **Collaboration \& Independence**: Work independently from a home office while leveraging internal experts and resources; build long\-term relationships with colleagues, clients, and partners. * **Project Ownership**: Drive issues to resolution with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring deliverables meet or exceed customer expectations and applicable standards. * **Continuous Improvement**: Contribute ideas that strengthen processes, tools, and customer outcomes; help others navigate change and adopt improvements. **Qualifications and Experience** **Experience:** * **2\+ years of forensic engineering experience required; 5–10 years preferred.** * Must be able to work independently and with a cross\-functional team of experts. * Strong technical writing skills are required; the ability to write effective reports is critical. Strong verbal communication skills are necessary; you should be an effective communicator in face\-to\-face interactions. * The ability to provide the utmost in customer service to our clients is a must. * Technical proficiency with computers, phones, cameras, etc. * Expert Witness experience is preferred. * You must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship or any restrictions. **Licensure:** * Professional Engineer (P.E.) license in Ohio is required, or eligible by reciprocity. **Physical \& Travel Requirements:** * Ability to perform fieldwork, including confined spaces and roof inspections. * Must be able to carry ladders and operate required equipment. * Willingness to travel locally, regionally, and nationally by vehicle or plane as needed. * Some overnight travel will be required. However, most investigations can be done without overnight travel. **Education:** * Bachelor of Science degree in Civil or Structural Engineering or a closely related degree from an ABET\-accredited university required. * Master of Science Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering preferred. **Location:** * Remote (home office) – Columbus, OH area **Compensation \& Benefits:** * Base salary range: $125,000 – $185,000 per year. * In addition to the base salary, the compensation plan includes additional, nondiscretionary compensation based on billable productivity above a minimum threshold. Employees may elect at any time to transition to a model based primarily on a higher percentage of their billable rate applied to all billable hours worked. In practice, most employees choose to transition between approximately one and three years, once their billable hours support consistently higher earnings under this model. This role is also eligible for a comprehensive U.S. based benefits package, including: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and company holidays * Wellness programs and employee assistance resources * Professional development support For more information, visit our full benefits overview here (https://salasobrien.com/benefits/). **Equal Opportunity Employment Statement** Salas O’Brien provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, or local laws. Salas O’Brien will accommodate the disability\-related needs of applicants as required by law. **Third\-Party Agency Notice** We do not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiters or agencies. We only work with approved partners engaged directly by our Talent Acquisition team for specific searches. Unsolicited submissions will not be eligible for placement fees. #### **Experience** Preferred* 2 year(s): 2\+ years of forensic engineering experience required; 5–10 years preferred. #### **Education** Required* Bachelors or better in Civil Engineering or related field #### **Licenses \& Certifications** Required* Professional Engineer Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Electrical Integration Engineer
jobs.description: At Hive, we're building the defining physical AI platform of the next decade. Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now. Our answer is a machine\-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement. Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe \- spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large\-scale chemical production \- with a US expansion underway. The vision: one operator managing hundreds of machines simultaneously. Productive machine\-hour cost dropping by 80x, and unlocks the next productivity revolution in physical work. The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it. **About the Role** ------------------ The Electrical Integration Engineer owns the electrical interface between the Hive autonomy system and each customer vehicle. This person designs robust, serviceable electrical integrations suitable for demanding industrial environments. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Analyze existing vehicle electrical architectures and interfaces. * Design vehicle wiring harnesses, power distribution, grounding, protection, and I/O circuits. * Select connectors, cables, fuses, relays, contactors, and other electrical components. * Define electrical interfaces between Hive hardware and OEM vehicle systems. * Design CAN physical connections, termination, isolation, and signal protection. * Produce schematics, harness drawings, connector tables, BOMs, and installation documentation. * Validate voltage drop, power quality, continuity, grounding, and communication integrity. * Support electrical safety reviews and fault analysis. * Lead electrical bring\-up and troubleshooting on customer machines. * Guide technicians through harness assembly, installation, testing, and rework. * Improve reusable electrical integration standards and components. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years of experience with automotive, off\-highway, robotics, industrial, or vehicle electrical systems. * Experience designing wiring harnesses and low\-voltage power distribution systems. * Strong understanding of connectors, grounding, shielding, circuit protection, and EMC practices. * Experience with CAN and J1939 physical interfaces. * Proficiency with electrical CAD and harness design tools. * Hands\-on experience with multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and CAN tools. * Ability to troubleshoot electrical systems directly on vehicles. * Experience producing release\-quality drawings, BOMs, and build documentation. * Willingness to travel regularly and work in customer facilities. Compensation Range: $140K \- $180K

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description: **Summary** Hyperion Automation is seeking a Project Coordinator to support the organization, communication, and follow\-through required to deliver custom automation projects successfully. This role reports to the Technical Project Manager and works closely with cross\-functional project teams to keep assigned work organized, maintain clear visibility to schedules, budgets, documentation, risks, open items, and client commitments, and help ensure issues are surfaced and addressed before they become project surprises. The Project Coordinator will begin by supporting active, complex projects and taking ownership of lower\-complexity projects within defined guardrails. The Technical Project Manager initially retains overall project accountability. The Coordinator is expected to build increasing independence through demonstrated judgment, communication, organization, and execution. For a strong performer, the role may provide an opportunity to develop toward a future Project Manager position based on demonstrated capability and business needs. Project coordination is the primary responsibility of the role. When project workload allows, the Coordinator may also provide limited, defined support to Supply Chain and shop\-floor logistics. We are looking for someone who is organized, proactive, dependable, and comfortable coordinating independently across different teams and priorities. Extensive automation or project\-management experience is not required, but the ability to learn quickly, communicate clearly, follow through consistently, and take increasing ownership is essential. The ability to have difficult conversations when communicating priorities, concerns, or delays internally and externally is also important. **About Hyperion** Hyperion Automation develops custom automation solutions and integrated systems for clients across a wide range of industries. Our clients bring us complex challenges, and our team takes ownership of developing the right solution from concept through design, build, integration, commissioning, and support. Our work brings together Engineering, Assembly, Supply Chain, Sales, and our clients to solve varied and often complex problems. In this role, you will work across those groups to help keep projects organized, communication clear, commitments visible, and execution moving forward. **Key Responsibilities** * Coordinate assigned lower\-complexity projects from kickoff through closeout within established project requirements and Technical Project Manager oversight. * Support larger or more complex projects through clearly assigned coordination responsibilities, follow\-up actions, client communication, documentation, and project tasks. * Maintain a clear, current view for the internal team of project status, upcoming milestones, open items, risks, blockers, and decisions needed. * Keep project schedules, action items, documentation, and project\-management systems current and useful. * Follow through with internal team members, clients, and vendors to keep commitments visible and work moving. * Surface stalled work, unclear ownership, missed commitments, or unresolved issues to the Technical Project Manager before they create larger project problems. Schedule, Budget, and Risk Awareness * Maintain visibility to project schedules, key milestones, budget status, labor and material activity, and other project constraints within defined responsibilities. * Proactively identify potential schedule, budget, scope, or execution concerns and bring them forward early, including when doing so requires a difficult conversation. * Support project budget and schedule forecasting through status updates with accurate, current information. * Help evaluate the impact of delays, changes, missing information, or conflicting priorities before they become project surprises. * Escalate issues that exceed assigned authority with clear context, impacts, and the information needed to support a decision. Client and Internal Communication * Provide timely, professional communication with clients on assigned projects and responsibilities. * Support and, when appropriate, lead routine project status discussions, follow\-up, and coordination. * Maintain clear communication between Engineering, Assembly, Supply Chain, Sales, Project Management, vendors, and clients. * Confirm responsibilities, next steps, and due dates when project discussions create new actions or commitments. * Communicate concerns directly and early to avoid uncertainty or missed expectations. * Escalate sensitive, commercial, technical, or high\-impact client matters to the Technical Project Manager or appropriate functional leader. * Represent Hyperion positively and professionally with clients and vendors. Project Documentation and Change Awareness * Maintain organized and current project records, including schedules, meeting notes, client communications, approvals, open\-item lists, and required project documentation. * Use Hyperion's proje ation. * Risks, delays, scope concerns, and missed commitments are identified early and addressed before they become late project surprises. * Follow\-up is consistent, commitments are closed, and project issues do not drift because of unclear ownership or lack of attention. * You demonstrate increasing independence and sound judgment while knowing when to make a decision, seek input, or escalate. * When supporting Supply Chain, you provide useful assistance without allowing secondary responsibilities to interfere with project execution. **Required Qualifications** * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, open items, and follow\-up simultaneously. * Clear, professional written and verbal communication with clients, vendors, and internal team members, with the ability to coordinate across functions and drive follow\-through without relying on formal authority. * Demonstrated reliability and follow\-through, including the ability to recognize when work is stalled, unclear, or at risk and take appropriate action. * Ability to work independently within established guardrails while knowing when to seek input or escalate a decision. * Strong attention to detail and comfort working with project schedules, budgets, and project data without losing sight of overall priorities and business impact. * Ability to learn new systems, processes, and technical concepts quickly. * Comfortable working across office and manufacturing environments, performing the light shop and material\-support activities described in this role, and communicating effectively with team members across different functional areas. * Willingness to travel to client sites as needed for assigned project responsibilities. * Working proficiency with common business software, including spreadsheets, email, document\-management tools, and project\-tracking systems. **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience in project coordination, project support, operations, manufacturing, engineering support, Supply Chain, client service, or a similar coordination\-focused role. * Experience working in a custom manufacturing, automation, systems\-integration, engineer\-to\-order, construction, or other project\-based environment. * Familiarity with project schedules, budgets, purchase activity, scope changes, documentation, and project closeout. * Experience communicating directly with clients, vendors, or cross\-functional internal teams. * Experience with Monday.com, ERP systems, or similar project and business\-management software. * Associate's or bachelor's degree in business, project management, engineering technology, operations, Supply Chain, or a related field. * Exposure to industrial automation, machinery, engineering, or manufacturing processes. **Benefits** * Medical, dental, and vision insurance options, with company contributions toward eligible coverage. * 401(k) retirement plan with Roth options and up to a 4% company match. * Life insurance. * $75/mo phone stipend. * $350/yr work clothing allowance. * $250/yr tool allowance. * PTO that increases with tenure, plus paid company holidays and a floating holiday. * Paid parental leave and company\-paid short\-term disability coverage. **Our Values** **WE CREATE GREAT LEADERS.** We cultivate the qualities that make great leaders, trusting one another and valuing the voice of every team member. **WE FORGE STRONG RELATIONSHIPS.** We take care of our people, whether they’re clients, community or team members. **WE RISE TO THE CHALLENGE.** We can automate anything—we’re not afraid of the most complex challenges. **WE ARE HYPERION.** We work as a team and for our team. We stand behind the brand and reputation we’ve built over more than 30 years. If you're someone who enjoys continuously expanding your skill set while tackling real\-world business problems, you'll feel right at home with us. Veterans and military spouses are especially encouraged to bring your unique and valuable experience to our team. **About the Role:** We are seeking an experienced Azure SQL DB SME to serve as the technical authority for the design, deployment, security, performance, and operation of Azure SQL database solutions supporting federal programs. The ideal candidate will bring deep hands\-on expertise across the Azure SQL family, including Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines, along with strong T\-SQL, performance tuning, high availability/disaster recovery, and database migration skills. You'll architect and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available database environments in Azure Government, lead migrations from on\-premises SQL Server, and partner with developers, data engineers, and DevOps teams to ensure applications and data pipelines are built on a reliable data foundation. By joining our organization, you'll help federal agencies modernize their data platforms and deliver better services to the people who depend on them! **Key Responsibilities** * Serve as the subject matter expert for Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Azure VMs, advising on the right deployment option, service tier, and purchasing model (vCore, DTU, serverless, elastic pools, and Hyperscale). * Design, provision, and configure secure, scalable Azure SQL environments in Azure Government using Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform), PowerShell, and Azure CLI. * Plan and lead database migrations from on\-premises SQL Server and other platforms to Azure SQL using Azure Database Migration Service, Azure Migrate, Data Migration Assistant, SQL Server Migration Assistant (SSMA), and BACPAC/DACPAC tooling. * Design and implement scalable, secure, and efficient data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF). * Develop and optimize ETL processes to ingest, transform, and store data in Azure Data Lake, SQL, and Synapse Analytics. * Write, review, and optimize complex T\-SQL, including stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, and indexing strategies. * Design and maintain relational data models and database schemas that support application, reporting, and analytics workloads. * Implement database security best jobs.title: Resourcing Coordinator - Dispatcher USA EDT
jobs.description: **About Indigo** ---------------- Indigo is a strategic operational partner for critical digital infrastructure. We help customers design, deploy, support and scale the infrastructure their businesses rely on, giving them greater control, consistency and confidence. Our teams work across subsea, terrestrial, wireless, data centre and NOC environments, bringing specialist expertise, 24/7 support, field services and managed services together under one accountable model. Being part of Indigo means working in a business where operational excellence, customer trust and doing things properly matter. We support customers in complex, performance\-critical environments, helping them reduce risk, protect performance and deliver with confidence. Our people are central to that mission, bringing the skill, responsiveness and accountability needed to support the next generation of digital infrastructure. As an Investors in People Gold accredited employer, we're committed to investing in the growth and development of our people. **About The Role** ------------------ Sitting within the Global Service Delivery team, the Resource Coordinator is responsible for planning, scheduling and coordinating engineering resources across the United States and Canada. Working closely with Engineering Managers, Partner Managers and operational teams, you'll ensure the right resources are deployed to customer incidents, maintenance activities and project work while maintaining service levels, resource utilisation and operational efficiency. The role requires an understanding of field service delivery within telecommunications, network infrastructure, managed services or data centre environments, enabling you to align the right technical resource to the right activity and support successful customer outcomes. This is a fully remote role supporting the Eastern Daylight Time Zone and is critical to ensuring the effective delivery of field services across North America. Candidates must be based in the United States and authorised to work without sponsorship. A valid passport is required for travel to the United Kingdom for initial onboarding and training. The successful candidate will require a suitable home working environment and a reliable hardwired internet connection with a minimum download speed of 100Mbps and upload speed of 20Mbps. OSHA\-10 certification, or willingness to obtain certification, is also required. **What You'll Do** * Plan and schedule engineering resources for break\-fix, maintenance and project activities across North America. * Coordinate internal engineers and third\-party partners, ensuring resources are assigned based on skills, availability, location and operational requirements. * Manage work allocation and scheduling activities through Salesforce Field Service Lightning (FSL), Field Nation and other field service management platforms. * Review scopes of work and resource requirements to ensure appropriately skilled engineers are assigned to customer activities. * Maintain awareness of engineering competencies, certifications and technical skillsets to support effective resource allocation. * Support the delivery of field services across network infrastructure, connectivity, cabling and data centre environments. * Review completed works and technician deliverables, ensuring customer requirements have been met and records are accurately maintained. * Maintain accurate records relating to resource availability, utilisation, training activities and absences. * Monitor resource capacity and utilisation, supporting workforce planning and forecasting activities. * Ensure customer service levels are achieved through effective scheduling, coordination and escalation management. * Manage and maintain access cards, keys and site access records. * Coordinate onboarding activities for new engineers, including access requirements, training and system setup. * Support maintenance of engineering skills matrices and coordinate training and shadowing opportunities. * Work closely with Service Delivery, Engineering, Project Management and Partner Management teams to continuously improve resource planning and operational performance. * Lead regular resource planning meetings and maintain accurate service and scheduling records. **About You** ------------- **What We're Looking For** **Essential** * High school diploma, GED or equivalent, with at least five years' experience in resource coordination, dispatch, scheduling, field services coordination or project coordination. * Experience scheduling and dispatching field engineers, technicians or operational resources across multiple locations. * Understanding of field engineering activities, technical skill requirements and resource allocation within telecommunications, network infrastructure, managed services or data centre environments. * Experience managing work orders through Field Nation, Salesforce FSL or similar workforce management or field service platforms. * Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers, partners and internal stakeholders. * Experience monitoring service performance and managing escalations through to resolution. * Strong administrative skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. * Ability to work independently, take ownership and follow tasks through to completion. **Desirable** * Spanish language skills. * Experience within a Managed Services, telecommunications, IT services, field services or data centre environment. * Experience using ServiceNow, Salesforce, Jira, Zendesk or similar platforms. * Knowledge of workforce planning, resource management and project coordination processes. * Understanding of structured cabling, fibre infrastructure, connectivity services or data centre operations. * Experience supporting multi\-site field service, infrastructure deployment or technical project delivery activities. At Indigo, we believe our greatest strength is our people. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience and potential. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, we're here to support you.

jobs.title: Staff Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Manufacturing \& Operations * JOB219455 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function of Position** The Staff Engineer, Manufacturing systems and Standards defines how manufacturing equipment is specified, developed, managed, and sustained across the company’s global manufacturing network. software readiness assessments and mission operations support as required. **Required Qualifications \& Experience :** **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. **Experience** * 15\+ years of experience developing software for embedded or real\-time systems. * Familiarity with NPR 7150\.2 * Experience supporting the complete software development lifecycle from requirements through acceptance testing. * Experience developing software within structured engineering processes utilizing industry\-recognized standards. **Desired Qualifications** * Experience supporting NASA, DoD, NOAA, or commercial spaceflight programs. * Flight software development experience for spacecraft, instruments, or ground\-support systems. * Familiarity with software acquisition and government flight projects. * Experience using: * IBM DOORS or equivalent requirements management tools * TDMS or equivalent configuration/data management systems * Git, SVN, or other software configuration management tools * Experience leading small software development teams or technical task groups. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work effectively in a collaborative NASA and contractor environment. * Self\-motivated jobs.title: Information Security Lead
jobs.description: Hybrid (2\-4 days/week in office): Boston, MA Headquarters Step into a pivotal Security Leadership role at a fast\-growing grid intelligence company. LineVision’s customers include eight of the ten largest US utilities, which demand the highest levels of security in order to protect sensitive data and the electric grid from attack. You will lead LineVision to achieve a security posture that exceeds industry standards and gives customers the confidence they need to rely on LineVision. Reporting to the VP of Security, IT, and Quality, you will have broad autonomy over security engineering, security operations, controls execution, governance, and compliance. You and a Security Analyst will own our SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 programs, risk management, incident response, penetration testing program, and customer security engagements. Partnering with IT, Platform, Hardware, and Customer Success, you will make security a strategic business advantage at LineVision. *If you want to build a security program that is seen as a strategic differentiator and wins customer trust, join us at* ***LineVision****,* ***Built In Boston Best Places to Work!*** Please note: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. **What will you do?** --------------------- ### **Core Responsibilities and Key Performance Objectives** * **Compliance Program Ownership:** Own the annual audit cycle for SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 using the Vanta compliance platform, including all controls, internal audits, external audits, and nonconformity tracking to closure. * **Risk Management \& Governance:** Lead the annual NIST CSF risk assessment, monthly Platform and Hardware risk reviews, and quarterly Governance, Risk \& Compliance reviews. Maintain policies and report ISMS efficacy metrics to leadership. * **Security Engineering:** Conduct AWS cloud and Sensor penetration tests, ISA/IEC 62443 product security assessments, vendor and product risk assessments. * **Security Operations:** Oversee vulnerability management, CrowdStrike Falcon Complete detection rules, NextGen SIEM data feeds, and the MSSP relationship. Monitor open\-source license compliance with FOSSA. * **Incident Response \& Resilience:** Own the incident response program and plan, including the annual 3rd part tabletop, business continuity and disaster recovery exercises, and implementation of lessons learned. * **Confidential Data Protection:** Define and guide data management controls, ensuring rigorous application of policies and customer contractual obligations regarding confidential data. Partner with Platform, Hardware and IT to apply controls across all company systems and applications. * **Customer \& Sales Support:** Lead responses to customer security questionnaires, contract security reviews, and customer\-facing security presentations and material. * **AI Security:** Identify risks and define security standards for enterprise and product AI. Inform the AI governance program with risk assessments and recommendations. * **Team Leadership:** Coach and develop the security team. * This role requires participation in a compensated rotational on\-call schedule. On\-call responsibilities are a condition of employment for this position. ### **Within the first 3 months:** * Establish operational rhythm with the security team, including 1\-1s, goal\-setting, and sprint planning. * Take ownership of the audit calendar, risk register, and security project portfolio. * Implement an intake and prioritization process for security work that surfaces trade\-offs and schedule risk early. * Take over customer security questionnaires and contract reviews, and build a reusable response library. * Lead monthly security risk reviews. ### **Within the first 6 months:** * Deliver SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 surveillance audits with no major nonconformances. * Complete an annual IEC 62443 security assessment of the product and track remediations. * Extend data controls beyond Google Drive to Atlassian, Slack, and email with the IT Lead. * Plan and conduct the incident response tabletop, and address findings. * Mature CrowdStrike detection rules and SIEM coverage. ### **Within the first year:** * Propose a 2–3 year security roadmap that fulfills LineVision’s vision for security excellence, including tooling, budget, and resourcing as the company grows. * Reduce questionnaire effort per customer through self\-service trust materials and a mature answer library. * Define security requirements for next\-generation sensors and platform features. * Establish ISMS efficacy metrics reported quarterly to leadership. * Lead quarterly Governance, Risk \& Compliance reviews with executive leadership. **How to succeed in this role** ------------------------------- ### **Key Competencies** * **Ownership**: take full responsibility for the security program's outcomes, from audit results to customer confide ta or similar compliance automation. * Experience in AI Governance and/or assessing the security of AI tools and features. ### **Reporting \& Team Structure** * Reports to the VP of Security, IT \& Quality. * Manages the Security Analyst. * Partners with the IT Lead on IT controls, identity, endpoint security, and CEII controls. * Partners with Platform, DevOps, and Hardware teams on vulnerability remediation, SDLC evidence, and disaster recovery. * Partners with Customer Success and Sales on customer security engagements, and with Legal on contract terms and incident response. ### **Interview Process** * **Apply Online.** * **Round 1:** Phone screen (Recruiter) * **Round 2:** Hiring Manager Interview * **Round 3:** Panel Interviews + Panel 1: Technical competency \& experience + Panel 2: Teamwork, culture fit, and customer presence * **Final Round:** Leadership Team \& Hiring Manager Sign\-Off **What does joining LineVision mean for you?** ---------------------------------------------- * **Impact.** Your talent, time, and energy will critically impact our success in accelerating our mission of providing utilities with grid intelligence to enable affordable, reliable power. * **Ownership.** You will hold broad responsibilities with high autonomy and trust in a communicative, collaborative, and fast\-paced environment. * **Flexibility.** You will be empowered to maintain work\-life balance with trust\-based PTO and a flexible work schedule. * **Real World Innovation.** You will join a motivated and high\-performing team working with cutting edge, patented technology to help solve key obstacles to meet the demands of an AI\-powered future. **Who we are…** --------------- LineVision is a grid\-enhancing technology company enabling electric utilities to deliver affordable, reliable power and accelerate the electrification of the global economy. Our grid intelligence platform delivers the most accurate, network\-wide dynamic line ratings and enables safer, more reliable grid operations with a combination of optical sensors and advanced environmental modeling. LineVision's global customer base includes eight of the ten largest US utilities, including National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. We are LineVisionaries: * **We are Innovators:** We light the way with tenacious creativity and do good work. * **We are Empowered:** With high trust and high autonomy, the floor is yours, and the opportunity is ours. * **We are Welcoming**: Come as you are, our doors are open. We are better together. * **We are Trusted Partners:** We elevate our customer champions through shared thought leadership. We deliver on commitments. * **We are All In**: We are building a community of passionate individuals who want to dent the universe. **Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S.** The base salary range for this role is $125,000\-140,000 USD. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, education, and other relevant qualifications. This role is also eligible to participate in a company bonus plan. In addition to base salary, LineVision offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision and disability insurance, commuter benefits, a 401(k) with company match, and trust\-based paid time off. Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements. At LineVision there’s no such thing as a "perfect" candidate. We are looking for exceptional people who want to make a positive impact through their work and facilitate an organization where everyone can thrive. So whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this role would make you excited to come to work every day. LineVision embraces AI, and we understand leveraging AI in your job search. As an actual member of LineVision's hiring team reviews every application, we kindly ask that any final materials you submit reflect your own voice and authentic human experience. Meet our team, and understand our mission: https://www.linevisioninc.com/about\-us

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Go\-to\-marketSales Overview **Sales Manager, Mid\-Market (San Francisco)** **Metaview** =========================================================== Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world\-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, ElevenLabs, and Airtable. Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised over $50m from top\-tier investors. Most recently, Google Ventures led our series B. We’re growing 5x YoY, our customers are raving fans of the product, and our story has been covered in Fortune, Forbes, TechCrunch, and The Times. It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re\-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives. **How we work** --------------- Four principles guide us: * **Velocity.** Optimize for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better. * **Hospitality.** Sweat the experience. Delight customers, candidates and colleagues, even when it’s inconvenient. * **Transparency.** Public unless private. Share context openly within the company so people and agents can take initiative. * **End\-to\-end.** Deliver outcomes, not tasks. Step beyond your job description and see the work through. **The role:** ------------- We’re hiring our first dedicated Mid\-Market Sales Manager in San Francisco, alongside a counterpart in New York. Each manager owns revenue, people, and performance for the Mid\-Market segment in their market; in San Francisco, you’ll report to the VP of Sales. The playbook is largely written and productive AE teams are already in place, but neither market has a finished system. You’ll build on that foundation with a high\-agency team that moves fast and owns its pipeline. In your first three months, you’ll work with Recruiting to fill open roles, assess each rep’s development needs, and show measurable impact on the segment forecast through hands\-on deal coaching and a stronger operating cadence. Key ownership areas: * Own Mid\-Market quota, revenue performance, and the segment forecast in San Francisco. * Recruit, onboard, lead, coach, and develop quota\-carrying Mid\-Market AEs, partnering with Recruiting to fill open roles and creating individual development plans from a team gap analysis. * Reinforce pipeline generation standards and MEDDPICC deal qualification, adapting the existing playbook to the team’s needs rather than building a new one from scratch. * Run pipeline\-generation prep and wrap\-ups, weekly pipeline and forecast reviews, and the reporting needed to see where performance needs attention. * Work alongside reps on live deals, offering direct coaching that improves deal conversion and consistency; partner with sales enablement and PMM to turn training and methodology into daily practice. **What you bring:** ------------------- * A record of leading quota\-carrying sales teams to consistent quota performance in a high\-velocity motion, with the ability to have an impact from the start. * The ability to identify, attract, and develop strong AE talent in a competitive hiring market, and to give direct, real\-time coaching on deals. * Experience holding a high bar for pipeline generation and MEDDPICC qualification while giving high\-agency reps room to own their work. * A builder’s approach to improving operating rhythms, reporting, and an existing sales playbook rather than relying on a finished system. * A growing operational playbook and readiness for second\-line leadership or an expanded\-region role within 12 months. **What we offer:** ------------------ * The best co\-workers you’ll ever have, in an environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance. * Supreme rate\-of\-learning as we re\-orient how the world works with AI. * High compensation, through cash and equity. * All the benefits you’d expect and more.

Option to join one of our Connected Communities. * **Innovation\-Driven**: Work on projects that matter—from sustainable materials to digital transformation. * **Community Impact**: Be part of a company that does what's right. Develop and maintain user documentation that facilitates model deployment and design standardization. Collaborate with product designers, manufacturing teams, quality engineers, and industrial partners to resolve design and production challenges. Monitor manufacturing and quality results to validate design performance and identify improvement opportunities. Lead or participate in continuous improvement initiatives that enhance design quality, efficiency, and process robustness. Develop new methods, digital tools, and innovative approaches that improve engineering workflows. Create visual training materials, guide technical design classes, and design documentation to support knowledge transfer and training. Anticipate technical risks and proactively develop solutions to support project success. Mentor and support new team members through coaching, training, and sharing best practices. **What You Will Bring** Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, or another engineering or technical field. Experience with 3D CAD modeling and parametric design principles. Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail and data accuracy. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multi\-functional environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships across teams and organizational levels. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Curiosity and a continuous improvement approach with a passion for innovation and design. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn new software applications and internal systems. Ability to successfully complete Michelin Design School training and certification (approximately nine weeks). Preferred qualifications: * Experience with CATIA or similar 3D CAD software. * Experience with scripting, programming, automation, Power BI, or data management tools. * Knowledge of manufacturing, quality systems, product development, or process improvement methodologies. * Experience creating technical documentation, training materials, or visual communication tools. \#LI\-hiringmichelin \#LI\-RG1 **Ready to Shape the Future of Innovation?** Michelin is building a world\-leading manufacturer of life\-changing composites and experiences. Your objective is to use global internal and external resources to define and enable equipment, yield, and output performance to achieve world\-class manufacturing results. This role involves establishing a proficient team of equipment engineers, recruiting and training shift technicians and engineers alongside the Manufacturing Engineering team, and jointly setting performance targets. This position requires collaborating with Technology Development, Process \& Equipment Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities as well as our global network of manufacturing sites. You must support effective collaboration across all geographies and departments, and external suppliers as well as international travel, as required. **Responsibilities:** * Lead an engineering team to achieve area goals, including improving equipment performance and installing new tools for a new fab * Develop the team’s strategic direction, allocate resources effectively, and maintain
