Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white\-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real\-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves. Traction: 30\+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500\+ active users, 10M\+ API calls processed daily, seven\-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time\-to\-go\-live by 70% and recovered 8,000\+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5\-month builds to 90% faster delivery. Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30\. We've raised $6\.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb \& Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating. We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Open doors**: Land net\-new logos across our core segments — supply chain, procurement, finance, and PSA software companies where an ERP connector is the thing standing between them and their next enterprise deal * **Map the maze**: Multi\-thread accounts, secure executive sponsors across Product and Professional Services, and build champions who can carry the business case internally * **Sell the blocker, not the feature:** Run consultative, value\-led cycles anchored on the cost of the status quo — stalled go\-lives, deals lost to integration gaps, engineering pulled into plumbing, margin leaking into SI spend * **Run crisp POCs**: Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and ROI; exit with a no\-doubt close plan. We're deliberately moving away from 4\-week POCs — help us prove value faster * **Orchestrate to win**: Partner with Marketing, Solutions, and Product to advance deals and set customers up to go live from day one * **Own numbers**: Deliver ARR targets with disciplined pipeline hygiene, forecast accuracy, and stage\-by\-stage conversion * **Execute plays**: Generate pipeline via outbound, inbound, partner co\-sell, events, and executive dinners — and write the plays that work into the playbook * **Close the loop**: Feed timely, specific market signal back to Product, Marketing, and Leadership. At this stage, what you hear on calls changes the roadmap **Role Information** * **Average deal size:** $50–100K land / $200–300K expand * **Average deal cycle:** 3–6 months * **Quota:** $1M first year, ramping to $1\.2–1\.5M in year two * **Selling into**: CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, and VPs of Professional Services / Delivery at software companies selling into enterprises that run SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or Dynamics * **Ideal customer**: Sales\-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors * **Current growth team:** 4 BDRs, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 post\-sales, and 2 partnerships **Required Skills \& Abilities** * Proven closer: 5–8 years in frontline sales with 2\+ in Enterprise SaaS, consistently at the top of the leaderboard * Enterprise hunter: Track record of landing and expanding complex, multi\-stakeholder deals at $100K\+ ACV * Technical cred: Comfortable demoing and positioning a deeply technical product. You can hold a real conversation about APIs, schema mapping, auth, in\-tenant/air\-gapped deployment, and why an integration broke — without reaching for a Solutions Engineer every time * Executive\-ready: Skilled at winning C\-level trust and navigating legal, security, and procurement with ease * Builder DNA: You don't just run plays, you write them. Forecast with rigour, operate with ownership, and be comfortable when the process doesn't exist yet * Presence matters: Based in the Bay Area and ready to collaborate in\-office 2–3 days a week (travel weeks excluded) **Nice to Have** * Sold integration, iPaaS, middleware, or data infrastructure — or sold against SIs and system integrators * Experience selling to platform teams, not just end enterprises * Sold a white\-labeled or embedded product where your buyer's customer is the end user * Early\-stage experience where you were the one building the territory, not working an assigned patch * Why do you want to work here? * Impact: Fast\-growing seed\-stage company ($6\.5M from Eniac Ventures \& Tidal Ventures) with early Fortune 500\-scale deployments and real, quantified customer outcomes * Speed: Founding\-team seat to build the GTM motion from the ground up, with a direct line to the founders and a clear path to sales leadership * Ownership: Cutting\-edge AI solving a high\-value enterprise problem nobody has cracked — backed by technical founders building a next\-generation infrastructure platform **Equal Employment Opportunity** We're a small, fast\-growing team, and we're intentional about building an inclusive culture from day one. jobs.title: AI Native Founding Product and Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over **2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries**, supported **by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals**. With **more than 145 years of service excellence**, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve t**he highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.** Our brand promise – **“when you need to be sure”** – underscores our commitment to **trust, integrity and reliability**, enabling businesses to **thrive with confidence**. We proudly deliver our **expert services** through the **SGS name** and a portfolio of **trusted specialized brands**, including **Applied Technical Services**, **Brightsight**, **Bluesign** and **Nutrasource**. **Job Description** We're reimagining a legacy system from the ground up. As the Founding Product \& Platform Engineer, you'll define the architecture, tooling, engineering culture and development practices behind the next generation of SGS digital products. You'll be equally comfortable designing distributed systems, building customer\-facing experiences, creating cloud platforms and writing production code. This is not a traditional architect role. We are looking for a builder. You'll lead by example, making key technical decisions through hands\-on delivery rather than governance. You'll help create the products that drive business impact while establishing the platform capabilities, reusable services and engineering standards that allow a small team to deliver at scale. If you're excited by greenfield environments, ambiguity, ownership and the opportunity to shape something from day one, we'd love to hear from you. **The Mission** Your dual mission is to: **Build exceptional digital products:** Lead the architecture and delivery of our most ambitious customer\-facing solutions, owning everything from frontend experiences to backend services and cloud infrastructure. **Build the engineering platform behind them**: Create the tooling, deployment pathways and reusable building blocks that allow engineers to move quickly, safely and independently. As successful patterns emerge, you'll transform them into shared capabilities that accelerate delivery across the organisation. **Key Responsibilities** * **Lead by Building:** Act as the technical lead on our most important initiatives, architecting through code and setting the standard for engineering excellence. * **Own the Full Stack:** Design and develop solutions across frontend, backend, cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. * **Build the Paved Road:** Shape our platform (CI/CD, Kubernetes, IaC, observability) so other engineers ship faster and more safely. * **Turn Solutions into Reusable Capabilities:** Identify successful patterns and convert them into shared services, frameworks, libraries and architectural standards * **Multiply Velocity:** Continuously remove friction from the development lifecycle through automation, standardisation and thoughtful platform design. * **Mentor and Influence:** Partner with engineers, product leads and designers to raise technical standards and encourage a culture of pragmatic, high\-quality delivery. **Qualifications** **What we’re looking for:** * **Full Stack Mastery:** Expert\-level React/TypeScript on the frontend, and deep experience building distributed backends in Go, Python, or TypeScript. * **Cloud \& IaC:** Hands\-on, architectural\-level experience with a major cloud (GCP, AWS) and Terraform. You don’t just use it; you architect with it. * **Containers \& CI/CD:** Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD pipelines built from scratch (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). * **Systems Thinking:** Proven ability to design scalable, resilient and observable systems. * **Product Mindset:** Experience working closely with Product and Design teams to deliver solutions that users genuinely value. * **Observability \& Quality:** Practical understanding of monitoring, tracing, testing and operational excellence, including tools such as Prometheus, Grafana and Jaeger. **Who You Are** * You have 10\+ years of experience, with strong backgrounds in both product engineering and platform/SRE work. * You are a builder first. You don’t run architecture review boards; you write the code that makes them unnecessary. * You believe the best architecture is the simplest one that works, and that great products and great platforms are built by the same kind of mindset. * You measure your success by the velocity, autonomy, and pride of the engineers around you. **Additional Information** **Why SGS?** * Opportunity to work with a global leader in inspection, verification, testing, and certification. * Collaborative and inclusive work environment. * Competitive salary and benefits package. * Opportunities for professional growth and development. Join Us: At SGS, we are dedicated to fostering an open, friendly, and supportive culture that thrives on teamwork. We value diversity and provide endless opportunities to learn, grow your expertise, and fulfill your potential.

jobs.title: Senior Azure Data Architect
jobs.description: Job Description: A federal agency already runs a production AI Assistant on Azure Government. You will be the technical authority who extends it to the case files, case records and legal documents of three more of its offices, so that an attorney or investigator gets a cited answer in seconds and never sees a page their role is not cleared to see. Full time, W\-2, starting 19 October 2026\. ### **Why this job exists** Our customer is a federal agency that enforces federal law. Its attorneys and investigators decide real cases from thousands of pages of case files, exhibits and correspondence. The agency has built the platform to search that record with AI. What it needs now is one senior person who can bring new offices onto it without weakening the access model that protects the people named in those files. This is a named Key Personnel position. You are the architect the agency's data and CIO staff will work with directly on design, and your resume is presented to the Contracting Officer for approval before you start. It is a builder's seat on a team of three: you, a Senior BI and Analytics Engineer, and a Program Manager who handles the customer, the schedule and the security writing so that your hours go to engineering. ### **The environment you will work in** You inherit a working stack and you build inside it. The agency operates the platform; you own what SPN builds on it. * Azure Government, with separate dev and test subscriptions and production behind an agency go decision * A governed PostgreSQL read replica fed by change data capture from the agency's case system * A dbt semantic layer and a data catalog * Approved Azure OpenAI services, a platform vector store, OCR and embedding services * Apache Superset for dashboards and AI\-assisted views * A production AI Assistant with retrieval guardrails already in place * The agency's Git repositories and CI/CD runners, where all code lives from the first commit * Python: pandas, SQLAlchemy, psycopg, the Azure OpenAI SDK and test frameworks ### **What you will do** * Own the technical design of every product and record each design decision in the agency repository * Register each office's case tables and document sets as sources, with a freshness expectation for each * Check every document for a native text layer and send only image pages to OCR * Hold pages below the agreed OCR confidence in a review queue instead of indexing them * Split text on headings, numbered paragraphs, exhibits and pages, and tag every chunk with its document, page, case, owning office and role scope * Keep the index current from the change stream, removing deleted, withdrawn and redacted material explicitly * Configure hybrid lexical and vector retrieval with rank fusion, suppress any sentence without a supporting source, and refuse when the evidence is weak * Compile each user's identity claims into a mandatory filter on every vector query, and write PostgreSQL row\-level security and field masking by role * Write an audit record for every retrieval and export * Measure retrieval recall, citation precision, groundedness, refusal correctness and access correctness against the agency's test set at every acceptance test * Build the CI/CD path that promotes dbt, Python and Superset assets from dev to test to production, with a probe that checks upstream schema and credentials before every scheduled run * Supply the configuration evidence and test results behind the NIST SP 800\-53 control statements, and fix penetration\-test findings on what we build ### **Your first 90 days** * Days 1 to 30: suitability forms filed on day one; source inventory and design for the first office; access\-control design reviewed with the agency * Days 31 to 60: the first office's content extracted, chunked and embedded in dev, returning cited answers; the paired\-role access test written * Days 61 to 90: AI features running inside the first product in dev; first measurement run against the agency's test set; the product ready for user acceptance testing in month 4 ### **How your work is judged** * Zero unauthorized\-access defects, proven by running the same query under paired roles before every promotion * AI quality measures at or above the thresholds agreed with the agency, for every office * No upstream change breaks a scheduled refresh without your probe raising it first * Every security control statement backed by evidence you produced ### **What you need** * United States citizenship, and the ability to obtain a Public Trust Tier 2 determination (the agency sponsors it) * A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology or a related field * 12 or more years in technology, 8 or more of them in cloud and data architecture * Azure architecture at the level of AZ\-305, by certification or by equivalent hands\-on work * At least one document question\-answering application with citations that you put into production, on Azure OpenAI or an equivalent * PostgreSQL or SQL Server at the level of writing row\-level security policies * Python * CI/CD in GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps ### **What sets a candidate apart** * An active Public Trust, Tier 4 or Secret, which can shorten the start to one to three weeks through reciprocity * CISSP or an equivalent senior security certification, or 5 or more years of security architecture * Production OCR or Azure Document Intelligence pipelines * Azure Government, pgvector or Azure AI Search * Apache Superset or another open\-source BI platform, and dbt * Written NIST SP 800\-53 control evidence for a Federal system ### **Benefits** Pay is discussed with you directly when we speak. These are the benefits every full\-time SPN employee receives. * Medical and prescription coverage, dental and vision * Short\-term disability * Life and accidental death insurance * Competitive 401(k) * 11 paid federal holidays * Paid vacation * Paid sick leave * Parental leave * Tuition and professional development assistance ### **Terms, and how to apply** * Full time, W\-2, salaried (exempt), employed by SPN Solutions * Target start: 19 October 2026 * Hybrid, based in Fairfax, Virginia, with some days in Washington, DC when needed * All customer work is done on a government\-furnished laptop with a PIV credential * SPN pays the exam fee for the Azure certifications tied to this role if you do not hold them Apply through the link with your resume. A recruiter reads every application and answers within two business days. If you have built a cited question\-answering system, tell us in two or three lines what it searched, who used it and how you kept people from seeing what they should not. SPN Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior BI & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description: Build the dashboards and AI\-assisted views that a federal agency's attorneys, field offices and program staff use to decide cases. You will sit with each office, define the product, build it in dbt and Apache Superset, prove every number against a count the office already trusts, and stay until people use it daily. Full time, W\-2, starting 19 October 2026\. ### **Why this job exists** Our customer is a federal agency that enforces federal law. This work is judged on one thing: products that the agency's legal, field and program offices accept and actually use. A dashboard nobody opens counts for nothing here. You are the person those offices will know. You run the working sessions, write down what decision the product supports, build it, and carry it through acceptance into daily use. You work on a team of three with a Senior Azure Data Architect, who gives technical direction and builds the AI features you embed, and a Program Manager who handles the customer relationship and the schedule. ### **The environment you will work in** * A governed PostgreSQL read replica of the agency's case system * The agency's dbt project, where you develop models and tests * Apache Superset, with a developer role in dev and test * A data catalog where every curated dataset is registered * The agency's Git repositories and CI/CD, with all work committed from day one * Python with pandas and visualization libraries for reconciliation and analysis * Accessibility tools: a screen reader such as NVDA or JAWS, a contrast analyzer, ANDI or axe ### **What you will do** * Run time\-boxed working sessions with each office and with the agency's data and CIO staff * Write each product definition: the decision it supports, the grain, the system of record, the inclusion rules, who may see it, and an example that proves it correct * Build dbt models with declared grain and tests for uniqueness, non\-null keys, referential integrity and accepted values * Build scheduled extracts that publish only after the full expected volume lands * Reconcile every figure to a count the office already trusts before it is released * Build Superset datasets over dbt models, never ad hoc SQL, then the dashboards and AI\-assisted views on top * Run acceptance testing with the office's own users: values reconcile, citations open, restricted roles see only what they should, and the interface works by keyboard * Pair every chart with a data table, carry no meaning by color alone, verify contrast, and test the whole task with a screen reader * Write the onboarding playbook, the user and administrator documentation, and run the enablement sessions * Document every pipeline: source, schedule, dependencies, failure behavior and owner ### **Your first 90 days** * Days 1 to 30: suitability forms filed on day one; Superset ramp with the Architect; working\-session kit built; first office discovery held * Days 31 to 60: first office definition approved by the agency; dbt models with tests built in dev; second office discovery scheduled * Days 61 to 90: first Superset product in dev with AI features embedded and reconciled to the office's control count; accessibility checks passing; acceptance script ready for month 4 ### **How your work is judged** * The first product accepted and in active use by month 7, and one for each office by month 10 * Every released figure reconciles to its control count * Every product passes all four acceptance confirmations * The adoption package delivered by month 9 and used by agency staff themselves by month 11 ### **What you need** * United States citizenship, and the ability to obtain a Public Trust Tier 2 determination * 5 or more years across data engineering and business intelligence * Advanced SQL * Python with pandas * Production experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker or Apache Superset * Git * A record of building for non\-technical users and getting them to adopt what you built ### **What sets a candidate apart** * An active Public Trust, Tier 4 or Secret * dbt in production * Apache Superset and PostgreSQL * WCAG testing experience or the DHS Trusted Tester certification * Work with legal, investigative or case\-management data * PL\-300 or DP\-600 * Living in the Washington, DC area ### **Benefits** Pay is discussed with you directly when we speak. These are the benefits every full\-time SPN employee receives. * Medical and prescription coverage, dental and vision * Short\-term disability * Life and accidental death insurance * Competitive 401(k) * 11 paid federal holidays * Paid vacation * Paid sick leave * Parental leave * Tuition and professional development assistance ### **Terms, and how to apply** * Full time, W\-2, salaried (exempt), employed by SPN Solutions * Target start: 19 October 2026 * Hybrid, based in Fairfax, Virginia, with some days in Washington, DC when needed; living in the Washington, DC area is preferred * All customer work is done on a government\-furnished laptop with a PIV credential * You complete the DHS Trusted Tester training in month 2 or 3 if you do not hold it; the training is free * If you come from Power BI, Tableau or Looker, the first two to four weeks include a Superset ramp with the Architect Apply through the link with your resume. A recruiter reads every application and answers within two business days. Tell us in two or three lines about one product you built that people who are not technical came to rely on, and how you knew the numbers were right. SPN Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Airplane Pilot

Power and named one of Arizona's best employers by Forbes. This role requires extensive flight operations experience and the ability to quickly acquire new aviation skills. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Serve as Pilot\-in\-Command (PIC) for SRP’s fixed\-wing aircraft, including a Cessna Citation 560 series airplane. * Conduct a variety of missions, including parts transport, corporate/VIP travel, and crew shuttles. * Operate in complex airspace (Phoenix metro area), throughout the U.S., and occasionally in Mexico. * Operate safely in high\-density altitude environments and in day/night IFR conditions. * Perform cross\-country flights, including overnight trips, as needed. * Execute short\-field takeoffs and landings. * Ground handle, load, and refuel aircraft as required. * Communicate with passengers regarding safety procedures and flight details. * Perform additional job\-related non‑flying duties as assigned to support overall flight department success. **Education** ------------- A high school diploma, GED, or equivalent is required. **Experience** -------------- * Minimum 3,000 hours fixed\-wing PIC time, including: + 1,500 hours multi\-engine + 1,000 hours turbine + 100 hours in make/model (or as required by insurance) * Valid ATP certificate required. * Valid type rating for Cessna 500 series (preferred) **Additional Requirements and Qualifications** ---------------------------------------------- * Demonstrated ability to exercise sound, independent judgment and self\-dispatch authority in alignment with SRP Safety Management Systems (SMS) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). * Proven capability to collaborate and communicate effectively with diverse SRP teams, including union trade personnel, engineers, environmental stakeholders, and corporate executives. * Availability to work flexible schedules, including overtime and non\-standard hours. * Ability to maintain an FAA Class II flight physical and a lifestyle that supports safe flight operations. * Strong safety judgment, including the ability to cancel, delay, or modify flights when safe outcomes cannot be assured, and clearly communicate these decisions while supporting alternate planning efforts. * Maintain proficiency in required IT systems, including SRP\-designated software, computers, and related equipment. * Completion of required ground school and simulator training relevant to SRP’s fixed\-wing aircraft within the past 12 months. * Routinely operate from hot, high\-altitude airports with up to 20\-30 knot crosswinds, using 80% to 100% of runway takeoff distance. * Ability to perform all required flight planning, including crew rest and customs requirements. * Prepare aircraft for flight, including cleaning and catering setup. * Participate in off\-site recurrent training and complete all required corporate training. * Fulltime Pilots must be available to report to Falcon Field within 45 minutes of notice, as needed. **Hybrid Workplace** SRP currently offers a hybrid workplace, which allows employees whose jobs can be performed remotely, and who have sufficient technical capability, to telework up to three days per week. Although teleworking is available, all employees must live and work in Arizona. **Drug/Alcohol Policy Statement** To promote the safety and well\-being of our employees, customers, and the communities we serve, SRP is committed to maintaining a drug/alcohol free work environment. Although marijuana may now be legal in Arizona, except as otherwise specified under Arizona law, SRP considers it to be an illegal drug for the purpose of our drug/alcohol policy because marijuana remains illegal at the federal level. Any candidate found to be impaired during the hiring process or who has the presence of an illegal drug or unauthorized substance in their system during the pre\-employment drug/alcohol test may be disqualified from further consideration in the hiring process. **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement** Salt River Project (SRP) is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military status, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state or local law. **Work Authorization** All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Currently, SRP does not sponsor H1B visas, OPT, or other employment\-related visa's. **Nearest Major Market:** Phoenix

leadership experience building, operating, and modernizing enterprise\-scale data, semantic, and knowledge platforms. * Strong understanding of data platform engineering practices, including platform architecture, ingestion, orchestration, transformation, observability, reliability, automation, performance tuning, cost management, security, and operational support. * Strong engineering and platform leadership experience supporting graph databases, semantic technologies, ontology\-driven solutions, knowledge graphs, metadata platforms, metrics layers, or related enterprise knowledge technologies. * Demonstrated experience leading teams responsible for the architecture, scalability, optimization, reliability, and operational support of graph database platforms, semantic layers, ontology services, and AI\-ready knowledge architectures. * Deep understanding of semantic technologies, contextual metadata management, entity modeling, relationship modeling, business vocabularies, knowledge representation, and trusted business definitions. * Hands\-on engineering background with the technical depth to guide architecture decisions, evaluate engineering tradeoffs, influence technology strategy, and provide credible leadership to architects and engineers. * Demonstrated success leading platform modernization, cloud transformation, engineering maturity improvements, and organizational change initiatives. * Experience leading enterprise Third\-Party Data capabilities, including external data acquisition, vendor\-enabled data services, onboarding frameworks, governance, compliance, and operational management. * Strong understanding of AI\-enabled data ecosystems, including GraphRAG, vector databases, vector search technologies, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Snowflake Cortex, Gemini Enterprise integrations, Agentic AI capabilities, and AI/ML integration patterns. * Exceptional strategic thinking, systems thinking, and problem\-solving transformation. * Experience influencing stakeholders and driving results in highly matrixed organizations. **Location Requirements:** * This role can have a Hybrid or Remote work arrangement. jobs.title: Design Infrastructure Engineer (EDA & Test)
jobs.description: WaveWorks makes wireless communication solutions for the next wave of connected devices. WaveWorks' unique technology provides extremely low cost, small form factor, and orders of magnitude lower power consumption, while achieving long operating range and high reliability. WaveWorks is expanding its engineering team and searching for high performing, dedicated individuals to help blaze new trails. **ROLE DESCRIPTION** WaveWorks is looking for a strong software and systems engineer to own the engineering environment its silicon team depends on. That environment is built on the Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens EDA tool suites, alongside other EDA and lab tools. The role covers the software, compute, EDA, data and automation infrastructure behind chip design, bring\-up, characterization and test. The goal is an engineering environment that runs like a mature production system: reliable, reproducible and able to scale, with tooling and infrastructure work taken off the IC designers. The right person will be given authority to direct information and IT infrastructure for a complex, deep\-stack technology startup building a multi\-faceted platform. This is not a chip design role and not corporate IT. The engineer is the technical owner of the systems that let analog, digital and verification designers do their jobs, and the software generalist the silicon team turns to when a new need appears. EDA tools are the first priority, but the scope is deliberately broad. **EDA ENVIRONMENT** * Install, configure and maintain the Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens EDA tool suites, their license servers, and other EDA tools, and make them work together reliably in one design environment. * Own the knowledge of how the design environment is assembled, and document it so that it does not depend on any one designer. * Open and track support tickets, reproduce and report failures, coordinate work with vendors, and drive issues to closure. **COMPUTE AND ENGINEERING INFRASTRUCTURE** * Run engineering workstations, compute servers, shared storage, and access control. * Build reproducible development environments, software deployment, and automation, including CI\-style workflows around design and test. **TEST AND CHARACTERIZATION SOFTWARE** * Build bench\-test automation and instrument\-control software for silicon bring\-up and characterization. * Build the pipeline for test data: acquisition, experiment metadata, parsing, storage, statistical analysis, plotting and reports. * Build regression and automated test suites, and tools to compare results across devices, lots, temperatures, configurations and silicon revisions. **ENGINEERING DATA** * Organize design files, test data, generated artifacts and technical documentation so they are stored predictably, versioned, searchable, tagged with metadata, and available to the right people. * Own version control across engineering: Git for software, scripts and configuration, and design data management for design libraries and PDKs, with branching, release and access practices the whole team follows. * Structure engineering data so later analysis and automation are possible. **INTERNAL SOFTWARE** * Write the internal tools, scripts, data pipelines, hardware\-control software and build tooling that the silicon team needs, including one\-off software to unblock a hardware engineer. * Use AI coding agents and modern tools as a standard part of the work, to build internal software quickly and remove recurring manual overhead. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * BS in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field plus 3 or more years of software or systems engineering experience, or an MS plus 1 or more years. * Strong software engineering in Python and at least one other language, with a record of building and maintaining tools other engineers rely on. * Expert use of Git and version\-control workflows, including repository administration. * Deep Linux systems administration: servers, storage, networking, user and access management, and scripting. * DevOps practice: configuration management, reproducible environments, containers, CI, and automation of repetitive work. * Daily, effective use of AI coding agents and assistants in engineering work. * High autonomy and breadth: able to take ownership of an undefined problem, such as a new test suite, and deliver it without close direction. * Enjoys building critical infrastructure and wants to own it. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience administering Synopsys, Cadence or Siemens EDA tools, including license servers and design\-environment setup. * Familiarity with IC design flows, PDKs, and design data management. * Lab automation and instrument control for semiconductor bring\-up or characterization. * Data engineering and statistical analysis of large test data sets. * Experience working with EDA or other technical vendors on support and escalation. * Firmware or embedded software experience. * Experience at a semiconductor or hardware startup. With its unique technology, WaveWorks is positioned to meet the needs of a plethora of applications of wireless connectivity that are not well served by conventional wireless solutions. Join us as we work to capture this opportunity and become a significant force in wireless. WaveWorks is committed to a friendly and welcoming working environment, and has a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. WaveWorks does not discriminate based on race, gender, age, religious affiliation, or any other legally protected status. WaveWorks is located in downtown Seattle, Washington.

jobs.description: ### **About Mecka AI** Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI. We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware\-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems. We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real\-world data, simulation, learning\-based systems, and deployed hardware. **The Role** Own the program that turns Mecka’s ego\-data pipeline into on\-time, at\-spec dataset deliveries to frontier AI labs. You will sit at the seam between our ego\-data sales \& delivery team and the engineering that produces the data — driving delivery execution against customer commitments while iteratively building the tooling, standards, and datasets that let us scale from bespoke drops to a repeatable delivery engine. jobs.description: **Company Description** OleOle is building a global social, messaging and commerce platform designed specifically for the more than three billion football fans around the world. The platform brings together social media, short\-form video, encrypted messaging and calling, live scores, real\-time translation and football content within a single global ecosystem. Our goal is to connect fans across clubs, countries and languages while creating an infrastructure that extends well beyond social media. Every OleOle user receives a persistent Wallet ID that connects their identity across the ecosystem. Over time, OleOle will integrate payments, commerce, Mini Programs, ticketing and travel, gaming, digital assets and financial services. Mini Programs will allow clubs, brands, merchants and third\-party developers to build services directly within OleOle, using the platform’s identity, social and payment infrastructure. OleOleSport, our ticketing and travel business, provides an important early commercial opportunity through tickets, VIP hospitality and travel experiences around major sporting events. As the OleOle audience grows, additional businesses are designed to scale alongside it, including Mini Programs, payments, gaming and NewZeros, our planned financial infrastructure combining exchange capabilities with a broader payments and transaction network. We are currently a team of approximately 20 people building across backend infrastructure, social, video, messaging, AI and translation, payments, football data, product and design. OleOle is being built around a long\-term thesis: football is the world’s largest shared passion, yet its global audience remains fragmented across social networks, messaging applications, sports platforms and commerce providers. We believe there is an opportunity to bring those experiences together in one global platform and build significant businesses around the resulting network. OleOle — Where Fans Kick Off. **Job Description** We are looking for a senior, hands\-on iOS engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of OleOle’s native iOS application. You will work directly with our backend, product and design teams to build the mobile implementation of OleOle’s social, messaging, video, live\-score and payments functionality. You will: * Architect and build the native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI. * Integrate backend APIs and realtime services as they are developed. * Build high\-performance social feeds and microblogging functionality. * Implement short\-form vertical video, including capture, upload, playback and media handling. * Implement encrypted one\-to\-one messaging and realtime chat. * Integrate voice and video calling. * Build contacts, invitations and user\-discovery functionality. * Implement live scores, realtime match events and push notifications. * Integrate authentication, account management and secure session handling. * Integrate wallet, payments and rewards functionality. * Implement localization and translation functionality. * Optimize startup, scrolling, media playback, networking, caching and battery usage. * Build reliable behavior for poor or intermittent network conditions. * Own testing, debugging and production reliability of the iOS application. * Take features from architecture through App Store production release. This is a hands\-on engineering role. We need someone capable of making architectural decisions and then writing the production code to implement them. Job Description We are looking for a senior, hands\-on Android engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of OleOle’s native Android application. You will work directly with our backend, product and design teams to build the mobile implementation of OleOle’s social, messaging, video, live\-score and payments functionality. You will: * Architect and build the native Android application using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. * Integrate backend APIs and realtime services as they are developed. * Build high\-performance social feeds and microblogging functionality. * Implement short\-form vertical video, including capture, upload, playback and media handling. * Implement encrypted one\-to\-one messaging and realtime chat. * Integrate voice and video calling. * Build contacts, invitations and user\-discovery functionality. * Implement live scores, realtime match events and push notifications. * Integrate authentication, account management and secure session handling. * Integrate wallet, payments and rewards functionality. * Implement localization and translation functionality. * Optimize startup, scrolling, media playback, networking, caching and battery usage. * Build reliable behavior across Android devices and poor or intermittent network conditions. * Own testing, debugging and production reliability of the Android application. * Take features from architecture through Google Play production release. This is a hands\-on engineering role. We nee deo capture, playback, compression, upload and media handling. * Strong understanding of Swift concurrency, networking, caching, memory management and mobile performance optimization. * Production experience with APNs, push notifications and background processing. * Experience implementing authentication, Keychain/secure storage, session management and privacy\-sensitive functionality. * Experience integrating complex backend APIs and working directly with backend engineers as APIs evolve. * Strong understanding of iOS application lifecycle, background execution and handling poor or intermittent network conditions. * Experience taking applications through App Store review, release and production operation. * Demonstrated ability to independently own a major application or feature from architecture through production. * Strong debugging, profiling, testing and production troubleshooting skills. * Must be a hands\-on engineer who writes production code, not primarily an engineering manager. Senior Android Engineer — Qualifications * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial native Android development. * Expert\-level Kotlin and strong production experience with Jetpack Compose. * Proven experience architecting, building and shipping complex consumer Android applications. * Experience building at least one substantial product involving social feeds, messaging, short\-form video, live content or realtime communications. * Strong experience with Kotlin Coroutines and Flow. * Strong experience with WebSockets and realtime/event\-driven mobile applications. * Production experience with WebRTC or comparable voice/video calling technology. * Strong experience with CameraX, Media3/ExoPlayer, including video capture, playback, compression, upload and media handling. * Strong understanding of Android networking, caching, memory management and mobile performance optimization. * Production experience with Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), push notifications and background processing. * Experience implementing authentication, Android Keystore/secure storage, session management and privacy\-sensitive functionality. * Experience integrating complex backend APIs and working directly with backend engineers as APIs evolve. * Strong understanding of the Android application lifecycle, background execution, device/OS fragmentation and poor or intermittent network conditions. * Experience taking applications through Google Play review, release and production operation. * Demonstrated ability to independently own a major application or feature from architecture through production. * Strong debugging, profiling, testing and production troubleshooting skills. * Must be a hands\-on engineer who writes production code, not primarily an engineering manager. Compensation This position currently operates under a written deferred compensation agreement while OleOle completes its funding round. This is not unpaid or volunteer work. Compensation is earned during the deferred period and becomes payable when the company closes funding. Following funding, the position transitions to a standard compensation package consisting of a competitive salary plus equity and OleOle token participation. **Additional Information** Solutions not problems . * Creative problem solver who can courageously propose and support new ideas to our organization. Not interested in best practices, lets build something better! * Ability to adapt. An ideal candidate will welcome the opportunity to solve a broad range of problems using a wide array of technologies. * Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and general growing pains of an early\-stage technology company * An exceptional entrepreneurial judgment that fosters independence over micro\-management * Understanding of football and international sports a huge plus Ole Ole is located in beautiful Austin Texas, however, this role requires some travel we are privately held and rapidly growing!

jobs.title: Remote Go (Golang) Developer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high\-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P\&L. **Project Overview:** As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting\-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections primarily in **Go**, as well as in Python, JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C\+\+, Java, and Rust; evaluating and refining AI\-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability; and working with cross\-functional teams to enhance enterprise\-level AI\-driven coding solutions. **What Does a Typical Day Look Like?*** Working on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in **Go**, along with Python, JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C\+\+, Java, and Rust. * Evaluate and refine AI\-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance AI\-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks. * Build agents that can verify the quality of the code and identify error patterns. * Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them. * Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task. **Required Skills:*** Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more) * Strong expertise in building full\-stack applications and deploying scalable, production\-grade software using modern languages and tools. * Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment. * Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales. **Engagement Details:*** Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week. * Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave). * Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit). * Location: candidates must be based out of US, Canada or WEU countries (Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, ...) **Evaluation Process:*** The application process takes 15\-30 minutes. * Completion of an AI video interview is required.
